title: Product Manager, Google Play App Safety Platform
job_description:
For Singapore Applicants:  
Google will be prioritizing applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require Google's sponsorship of a visa.  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Singapore; Bengaluru, Karnataka, India**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
* 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc).
* Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree in a technology or business related field.
* 3 years of experience in a business function or role (e.g., strategic marketing, business operations, consulting).
* Experience with mobile app security, app store ecosystems, or content moderation platforms.
* Technical familiarity with LLM security evaluation, AI threat models (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLMs), or static/dynamic code analysis tools.
* Strong data-driven mindset with experience defining and optimizing multi-objective platform metrics (safety vs. speed vs. operational cost).

**About the job**
-----------------

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  

The App and Ecosystem Trust (AET) team ensures safe, secure, and trustworthy experiences across our global app ecosystem. Mokka is the core review engine that processes every app submission, update, and runtime signal to protect billions of users from security vulnerabilities, policy violations, and malicious behavior.  
  
As the Product Manager for Mokka, you will take the lead on driving the overall strategy and tactical execution of our next-generation review infrastructure. Your core mission is to bridge advanced ML-driven detection capabilities with developer velocity, ensuring our entire ecosystem remains secure without unnecessary friction.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Define the multi-year product roadmap for Mokka, the app safety review platform, to scale under submission volume increases driven by AI-assisted code generation (vibe coding).
* Architect automated static, dynamic, and LLM-assisted review pipelines that intercept modern security threats before apps reach production. Design robust defenses against emerging AI vulnerabilities, including malicious model weights, indirect prompt injection vectors, agentic permission escalation, and generative privacy leaks.
* Balance friction-free onboarding for legitimate developers with rigorous verification checks for high-risk or automated app factories.
* Partner with Operations and Policy teams to design intelligent human-in-the-loop review interfaces, leveraging generative AI assistants to speed up analyst workflows and reduce manual cognitive load.
* Partner closely with ML Research, Security Engineering, Policy Operations, and Developer Relations across global sites (US, Bangalore, London, Singapore) and drive alignment across vertical AET teams (e.g. Content, Malware)

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager, Advanced
job_description:
**Overview:**

At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.

Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve.

You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally.

Come make an impact every day at Zebra.

**What We're Looking For:**

The Product Manager, Advanced plays a pivotal role in shaping the company's product offerings, ensuring products meet market demands, and enhancing customer satisfaction. This role focuses on developing expertise in product lifecycle management, competitive market analysis, and cross-functional collaboration while contributing to innovation and business growth. This is an opportunity to influence product vision, solve complex problems, and create value for customers worldwide.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**  
• Develop a deep understanding of Zebra's products, competitive landscape, distribution channels, and customer needs
  
• Advocate for the voice of the customer, integrating their feedback into product development processes
  
• Act as a bridge between technical teams and business stakeholders, ensuring seamless communication and alignment
  
• Define and execute demand generation initiatives in an effort to drive realization of product revenue plans in collaboration with regional product and marketing
  
• Owns product lifecycle management for assigned product lines including tactical execution, managing customer requirements, developing and driving end of life plans and execution of inventory objectives

• Define and manage product offerings following the New Product Introduction (NPI) process
  
• Drive innovation by identifying and leveraging emerging technologies to create competitive differentiation
  
• Mentor and guide junior team members, sharing best practices and industry knowledge
  
• Provides recommendations to influence distribution strategy to meet market needs
  
• Supports product launch by providing a comprehensive understanding of the value proposition
  
• Deliver product training to sales, sales engineers, technical support and other internal and external stakeholders
  
• Works closely with development teams and other key stakeholders to oversee new product development to validate development is on spec. Identifies beta site targets and drafts and implements plans

**Key Skills and Competencies:**

* Experience with AI-driven tools, such as machine learning-based diagnostic systems, virtual assistants, or predictive maintenance solutions to improve customer support operations
* Strong problem solving skills and the ability to make data driven decisions
* Advanced proficiency in tools such as Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, JIRA, and Confluence
* Familiarity with Agile methodologies and tools such as Scrum and SAFe frameworks
* Knowledge and understanding of SW applications relevant to the use of the products for the markets and use cases enabled by the products
* Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to convey complex ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Strong business acumen and customer orientation with a proven ability to balance customer needs with business goals
* Advanced knowledge of market dynamics and competitive landscapes in relevant categories

  
**Minimum Education or Equivalent:**  

* Bachelors Degree in related discipline. Advanced Degree also acceptable. Candidates with 6+ years of experience will be considered if they hold a Masters Degree. In lieu of a degree, candidates with 12+ years of extensive and relevant product management experience and technical expertise will be considered if they have advanced knowledge of market dynamics, a track record of mentoring junior team members, and strong leadership, problem-solving, and communication skills to bridge technical and business stakeholders. Must be able to demonstrate evidence of an entrepreneurial mindset

**Minimum Work Experience:**

* 8+ years of experience

**Work Environment:** Hybrid

**Safety Sensitive Role:** No

**Travel:** Up to 25%

**Personal Protective Equipment (PPE):** No

**Must be able to see color:** No

**Physical Demands:**  

* Sedentary work that primarily involves sitting or standing

**Benefits:**

We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success.

**Job Posting Statement:**

To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra.com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department.

**AI Technology Statement:**

Zebra Technologies leverages AI technology to evaluate job applications using objective, job-relevant criteria. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. However, every decision regarding interviews and hiring is made by our dedicated team, because we believe people make the best decisions about people. For more on how we use technology in hiring and how we process applicant data, see our Zebra Privacy Policy .

author: Hiring Manager
title: Principal Product Manager IT/OT D-Hub
job_description:
**At Bayer we’re visionaries, driven to solve the world’s toughest challenges and striving for a world where ,Health for all, Hunger for none’ is no longer a dream, but a real possibility. We’re doing it with energy, curiosity and sheer dedication, always learning from unique perspectives of those around us, expanding our thinking, growing our capabilities and redefining ‘impossible’. There are so many reasons to join us. If you’re hungry to build a varied and meaningful career in a community of brilliant and diverse minds to make a real difference, there’s only one choice.**

  

**Principal Product Manager IT/OT D-Hub**

**POSITION PURPOSE:**

The Principal Product Manager is responsible for the overall product vision, strategy and roadmap across a specific Platform or domain and works on the hardest problems within the Platform. They make specific contributions to Product and Platform delivery by working directly with Product Squads within the Platform to ensure each product is oriented toward business outcomes that improve company performance. The Principal Product Manager partners directly with the Platform Lead and their teams to deliver. The Principal Product Manager is an expert communicator that represents the Platform by presenting to senior leaders across Bayer and externally to accelerate digital transformation and build Bayer’s reputation as a digital leading company.

Principal Product Managers apply the product management discipline to some of the hardest problems within the Platform. They ensure that products are fulfilling their primary purpose to enable users to perform tasks that create value for the company by:

* Setting strategic vision for the product to ensure the customer and their needs are at the center; and ensuring team priorities are supporting business outcomes for customer, product, technical and enabling teams. This requires continual alignment of the product strategy and objectives with customer, product, technical, and enabling teams

* Managing the product backlog, which prioritizes the work of the assigned squads, to achieve the vision and aligned strategy.

To successfully manage these areas of responsibility, Principal Product Managers must have a deep understanding of the product domain, related technology, and architecture.

  

**YOUR TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **Product Management**

The product manager is accountable for the overall success of a product throughout its lifecycle, from conception to decommissioning. They identify domain needs, develop, and validate product concepts, and build a business case. They oversee the product's build and launch, including any sourced services; as well as ensure product availability, stability, and compliance needs are met. Product managers collaborate with various teams, including product development, marketing, finance, legal, manufacturing, operations, and sales, as needed, to ensure cohesive progress and success.

Product Managers drive agile best practices with the team to improve delivery, including continuous planning ahead of each development cycle (e.g. sprint planning) and working together to co-create user stories aligned with the product backlog prioritization. In addition to guiding the team product managers have duties like market opportunity identification, competitive analysis, sales enablement, or monitoring domain performance.

* **Stakeholder Engagement**

It is vital for the product manager to identify their key stakeholder group. Though many strong and loud opinions will be expressed, an effective product manager uses discretion to deliver their product in a way that meets the needs of users and stakeholders who will ensure value is realized for Bayer. Stakeholders should trust that the product manager not only understands their needs but will actively work to ensure their needs are met while delivering the product.

* **Product Strategy**

The product manager must provide strategic leadership with full end-to-end ownership for their assigned products throughout the entire product lifecycle. They are responsible for planning and optimizing capabilities to deliver business outcomes in the most efficient way. Product managers require strong strategic planning, decision making, and influencing skills to balance the needs of users and various stakeholders.

* **Product Discovery & Delivery**

The product manager is responsible for creating comprehensive product roadmaps, to clarify user needs and non-functional requirements. They provide product oversight by tracking and reporting progress against 90-day outcomes and overall product health (including budget responsibilities). They also plan and manage product delivery while streamlining the corresponding backlog. Product managers are responsible for monitoring user feedback and metrics to co-create solutions that drive a better user experience and deliver more business value. They leverage Design Thinking methodology starting with user needs to prioritize problems and through discovery they perform usability, feasibility, business fit and value testing to determine the optimal solution.

* **People & Collaboration**

Product managers must proactively communicate and collaborate with product users and stakeholders, which requires strong strategic communication skills. Effective cross-functional collaboration is critical for product managers, bringing together diverse skills and knowledge to deliver a valuable product. It's important to maintain strong and productive working relationships with colleagues in product management, engineering, and other technically focused organizations. The Principal Product Manager serves as a Product Management Chapter Lead for their Platform, where they are responsible for development of the product management community to improve product management and agile practices, fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.

  

**WHO YOU ARE:**

**Required -**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or similar or minimum 4 years equivalent practical experience in addition to:
* 10 or more years of experience as a product manager
* 5 or more years of experience with Agile development and DevOps

**Preferred –**

* Demonstrated ability to lead through influence initiatives that involve cross-functional teams from initiation to delivery
* Demonstrated experience with Design Thinking, user-centered design & user analysis
* Ability to establish and manage initiatives against a set of key metrics and goals
* Expert analytical, management and organizational skills
* Expert verbal and written communication abilities: must effectively communicate with technical and non-technical people
* Expert Experience in building product vision, product roadmap, product strategy, and competitive analysis
* Proven experience in designing, developing, delivering or leading digital solutions in a large-scale, highly complex global environment
* Strong strategic planning and decision-making skills with ability to evolve solution strategy based on research, data and industry trends
* Ability to measure and effectively communicate the business value of proposals and deliverables

  

**Ever feel burnt out by bureaucracy? Us too. That's why we're changing the way we work- for higher productivity, faster innovation, and better results. We call it Dynamic Shared Ownership (DSO). Learn more about what DSO will mean for you in your new role here**

**https://www.bayer.com/enfstrategyfstrategy**

**Bayer does not charge any fees whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not entertain such demand for payment by any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any Bayer Group entity(ies) worldwide under any pretext.**

**Please don’t rely upon any unsolicited email from email addresses not ending with domain name “bayer.com” or job advertisements referring you to an email address that does not end with “bayer.com”. For checking the authenticity of such emails or advertisement you may approach us at HROP\_INDIA@BAYER.COM.**

**YOUR APPLICATION**

  
  

Bayer is an equal opportunity employer that strongly values fairness and respect at work. We welcome applications from all individuals, regardless of race, religion, gender, age, physical characteristics, disability, sexual orientation etc. We are committed to treating all applicants fairly and avoiding discrimination.

**Location:**

India : Karnataka : Bangalore

  

**Division:**

Enabling Functions

  

**Reference Code:**

896367

**Contact Us**

  
  

+ 022-25311234

Product managers collaborate with various teams, including product development, marketing, finance, legal, manufacturing, operations, and sales, as needed, to ensure cohesive progress and success.

Product Managers drive agile best practices with the team to improve delivery, including continuous planning ahead of each development cycle (e.g. sprint planning) and working together to co-create user stories aligned with the product backlog prioritization. In addition to guiding the team product managers have duties like market opportunity identification, competitive analysis, sales enablement, or monitoring domain performance.

* **Stakeholder Engagement**

It is vital for the product manager to identify their key stakeholder group. Though many strong and loud opinions will be expressed, an effective product manager uses discretion to deliver their product in a way that meets the needs of users and stakeholders who will ensure value is realized for Bayer. Stakeholders should trust that the product manager not only understands their needs but will actively work to ensure their needs are met while delivering the product.

* **Product Strategy**

The product manager must provide strategic leadership with full end-to-end ownership for their assigned products throughout the entire product lifecycle. They are responsible for planning and optimizing capabilities to deliver business outcomes in the most efficient way. Product managers require strong strategic planning, decision making, and influencing skills to balance the needs of users and various stakeholders.

* **Product Discovery & Delivery**

The product manager is responsible for creating comprehensive product roadmaps, to clarify user needs and non-functional requirements. They provide product oversight by tracking and reporting progress against 90-day outcomes and overall product health (including budget responsibilities). They also plan and manage product delivery while streamlining the corresponding backlog. Product managers are responsible for monitoring user feedback and metrics to co-create solutions that drive a better user experience and deliver more business value. They leverage Design Thinking methodology starting with user needs to prioritize problems and through discovery they perform usability, feasibility, business fit and value testing to determine the optimal solution.

* **People & Collaboration**

Product managers must proactively communicate and collaborate with product users and stakeholders, which requires strong strategic communication skills. Effective cross-functional collaboration is critical for product managers, bringing together diverse skills and knowledge to deliver a valuable product. It's important to maintain strong and productive working relationships with colleagues in product management, engineering, and other technically focused organizations. The Principal Product Manager serves as a Product Management Chapter Lead for their Platform, where they are responsible for development of the product management community to improve product management and agile practices, fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.

  

**WHO YOU ARE:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or similar or minimum 4 years equivalent practical experience in addition to:
* 10 or more years of experience as a product manager
* 5 or more years of experience with Agile development and DevOps

**Preferred –**

**About the role**  
  
We are hiring a Product Manager — Household Data Products to own a portfolio of data products within Target's Household product line: from household definitions and taxonomy, through certified datasets, pipelines, quality and governance, to the applications that Media, Promotions, Merchandising and Loyalty teams use to make decisions.  
  
Household is how Target understands its guests as the real-world units that shop together. This role takes the household foundation and turns it into trusted, reusable data products and decision-ready applications — answering questions like which households we acquired, retained or reactivated, what drove it, and how we should market, promote and assort for them.  
  
This is a hands-on role that works closely with Data Engineering, Analytics, Data Science, Identity and business partners. You will partner with DE day-to-day across a medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) architecture, shape schemas and data contracts, and make sure household data products are trusted, well-governed and adopted. The core job is to translate technical capability into business outcomes.  
  
**What you’ll own**  
  
**Household Foundations – Must Have**  
  
You will help build and own the household foundation layer that every downstream use case depends on: stable, certified household datasets built on the enterprise household identity (owned by the Identity team), with consistent definitions that business partners can trust and reuse.

* Household lifecycle definitions and formats — acquisition, retention, reactivation and new-to-category — agreed with Analytics and Finance and published as certified data products.
* Household attributes and taxonomy — life stage, composition, demographics, interests and purchase behaviour, including third-party enrichment — with clear ownership, lineage and refresh cadence.
* Household-level enterprise KPIs such as household-based conversion, taken from definition through UAT, sign-off and production.

**Household Applications – Must Have**  
  
You will help turn the foundation into applications that change decisions across the enterprise, delivering against a roadmap shaped with your manager and business partners:

* Media — map household cohorts to the campaigns they were exposed to, starting with diagnostics and extending to Roundel (retail media) audiences and measurement.
* Promotions — connect households to promotion performance so promo teams can see who a promotion actually reached and moved.
* Merchandising — household views of newness-led acquisition and assortment relevancy by life stage.
* Enterprise growth — an acquisition and reactivation waterfall across drivers (marketing including Roundel, promotions, brand marketing, newness and assortment, new stores), plus who the acquired households are.

**Analytics & Data Fluency — Must Have**  
  
Strong working knowledge of analytics and data concepts, with the ability to partner effectively with Analytics and Data Science teams. You should be comfortable with:

* Household and guest-level analytics, cohorts and segmentation
* Entity resolution and identity concepts (guest-to-household mapping, match rates, stability)
* Data aggregation and dimensional modelling
* Data quality, reconciliation and metric definitions in a semantic layer
* Privacy, consent and responsible use of guest and household data

**Building data products with Data Engineering**  
  
You work hand-in-hand with Data Engineering to turn requirements into real datasets and pipelines — translating business needs into clear specs and data contracts, prioritising the backlog, and making trade-off calls with DE on design, cost and sequencing.  
  
**Platform & ecosystem stewardship**  
  
Solid understanding of our data platform and cloud environment (GCP, BigQuery, Power BI). You make household data easy to discover, access and consume — through the certified gold layer, documented data products and self-serve paths for analysts and downstream platforms.  
  
**Trust, governance & data quality — critical**  
  
Data governance and data quality are central to this role, not an afterthought. Household data drives audience targeting, measurement and executive reporting, so an unstable household ID or a wrong definition ripples across every team that uses it. You own certification, quality monitoring, access and consent controls for the household product line.  
  
**Stakeholder partnership**  
  
You will work with partners across Marketing, Roundel, Loyalty, Promotions and Merchandising to gather requirements, clarify competing asks, and communicate progress, trade-offs and impact clearly to stakeholders and leadership.  
  
**What you’ll bring**

* 3–5 years in product management (or 5+ years in closely related data, analytics or engineering roles with product exposure), with experience on customer or household data products, CDP / customer 360, identity, data platforms, or AdTech/MarTech and retail media.
* Strong understanding of customer and household analytics — lifecycle (acquisition, retention, reactivation), segmentation, cohorts and life-stage modelling.
* Familiarity with identity resolution and householding concepts, and with how household data powers audiences, measurement and personalisation.
* Hands-on experience working closely with Data Engineering to build datasets and pipelines — writing specs, shaping schemas and contracts, and prioritising a technical backlog.
* Solid understanding of medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold) and modern data platforms (lakehouse, data mesh or federated architectures), including lineage and cost.
* Strong grasp of data governance and data quality — certification, monitoring, access, privacy and consent — treated as critical, not optional.
* Experience translating technical capability into measurable business outcomes and working effectively with cross-functional partners without direct authority.
* Strong product management practices and excellent communication with Data Engineering, Analysts, Data Scientists and business stakeholders.
* Nice to have: exposure to marketing measurement (attribution, MTA, MMM), promotions or merchandising analytics, or third-party data enrichment.

**Know More About Us here:**

* **Benefits**: https://india.target.com/life-at-target/workplace/benefits
* **Culture**: https://india.target.com/life-at-target/belonging
* **Target** **Tech**: https://tech.target.com/

### **Senior Product Manager – AppsForBharat**

**Location:** HSR Layout, Bangalore
  
**Role Type:** Full-time

**Role Overview - Senior Product Manager**

As Senior Product Manager for Sri Mandir Web, you will own the end-to-end product lifecycle for building a fast, engaging, and trustworthy website that serves millions of devotees worldwide. This is a first-principles, high-ownership role, you will be expected to question existing assumptions, reimagine devotee journeys for the web (a fundamentally different medium from app), and build measurable, compounding growth loops around acquisition, engagement, and monetisation.

You will be especially responsible for how devotees are acquired, including through SEO. Reimagine how devotees experience the site pre and post-transaction in their journeys and turn a one-time visitor into a returning, engaged devotee.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

***Product Vision & Strategy***

* Define and own the Sri Mandir Web Product roadmap, grounded in first-principles thinking that works for Web audience.

* Identify the highest-leverage problems in the devotee journey by breaking them down to root causes, not surface symptoms.

* Work with Website P&L lead, to own the complete business flywheel and deliver retention and revenue outcomes

***Acquisition & Organic Growth***

* Own complete acquisition funnels with a strong focus on organic and SEO-driven growth alongside paid and referral channels.

* Partner closely with Analytics, CRM, Content, Marketing, Design and Engineering teams to define the site architecture that drives speed and enable discoverability at scale.

***Engagement & User-First Journeys***

* Apply deep, empathetic, user-first thinking to design web journeys that feel intuitive, trustworthy, and delightful for devotees

* Design and continuously refine post-transaction user flows, cross-sell and re-engagement journeys, that build habitual, repeat engagement

***Data-Driven Decision Making***

* Leverage analytics, cohort analysis, user research, and market insights to identify problems, size opportunities, and prioritise the roadmap.

* Set up and track KPIs across the funnel, traffic, conversion, ARPU, retention, and repeat transactions

***Ownership & Cross-Functional Leadership***

* Lead the product lifecycle from concept and requirements to launch and post-launch optimisation.

* Stay ahead of web/SEO trends, competitor moves, and emerging technologies to keep Sri Mandir Web at the frontier of devotional tech.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* Bachelors or Masters degree from Tier 1 premier institute — IIT, BITS Pilani, IIM, ISB preferred.

* Experience: Minimum 4+ years of B2C product management and growth experience, with measurable impact on Revenue, CRO LTV and Retention

* First-principles thinker: Demonstrated ability to solve ambiguous, complex problems from the ground up rather than relying on existing playbooks.

* Web acquisition & SEO: Product knowledge of SEO and organic acquisition levers (technical SEO, content strategy, site performance)

* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex, funnel-level datasets.

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Bonus Points**
----------------

* Past founding or entrepreneurial experience.

* Hands-on experience with SEO/organic growth as a primary growth lever in a previous role.

* Experience managing products across Web platforms.

* Past experience building and growing e-commerce products.

Let’s build something meaningful together. ✨

job_description:
**Company Description**

**About the Company -**

(https://www.mastersindia.co/)

Masters India IT Solutions is a growing **B2B SaaS Product Company**, serving over 1500+ large enterprises. We are proud to be **Great Place To Work – Certified™**, reflecting our commitment to building a positive, growth-oriented workplace culture.

Masters India is one of the biggest GST Suvidha Providers (GSP) appointed by the Goods and Services Tax Network (GSTN) of the Government of India since 2017. Our mission is to build intuitive software solutions that simplify complex challenges faced by businesses across industries. We are fulfilling this mission by offering tax and financial automation products to enterprises.

Masters India IT Solutions is part of the 45-year-old Masters India Group, which has a diversified presence across Manufacturing, Healthcare, Hospitality, and IT, with an aggregate turnover of INR 1000+ Crores.

 **Job Description**

**Role Overview**

**We are looking for a Chartered Accountant (CA) with hands-on experience in Product Management to build the strategy, roadmap, discovery and execution of our GST and e-invoicing platform.**

**This role sits at the intersection of tax regulations, finance operations and technology. You will be responsible for translating evolving statutory requirements and real-world taxpayer challenges into scalable, intuitive and technology-led SaaS products.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Regulatory & Product Planning**

* **Bring GST and Compliance expertise to product development, so that features are accurate, follow the law and are ready for regulatory changes on time.**

**Track GST Council decisions, CBIC/GSTN notifications and IRP/NIC changes, and turn them into product initiatives delivered ahead of compliance deadlines.**

* **Help prioritise initiatives based on customer impact, business value, regulatory urgency and technical feasibility.**
* **Spot market gaps and customer needs across enterprises, ERP ecosystems, GSPs/ASPs, tax practitioners and CA firms.**

**Domain Ownership**

* **Own the functional understanding of GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-2A/2B, GSTR-9/9C, ITC reconciliation, e-invoicing and e-way bills.**
* **Translate law, rules and notifications into clear requirements, business rules, validations and user workflows.**
* **Define reconciliation logic and exception handling that improve accuracy, cut manual effort and reduce compliance risk.**

**Discovery & Execution**

* **Talk to customers, finance teams and CAs to understand workflows and pain points; validate ideas through prototypes and feedback.**
* **Identify AI and automation opportunities such as invoice data extraction, anomaly detection and reconciliation assistance.**
* **Write PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria and test scenarios; work with engineering on APIs, ERP integrations and system workflows.**
* **Lead UAT and functional validation to ensure regulatory accuracy and quality before release.**

**Required Skills & Experience**

**Must-Have**

* **Educational Qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA) with a demonstrated transition into Product Management.**
* **Domain Expertise: Strong working knowledge of Indian indirect tax, particularly GST law and processes, GST returns, ITC reconciliation, e-invoicing and e-way bills. Exposure to GSP/ASP ecosystems, GSTN, IRP and NIC APIs**
* **Product experience: Hands-on experience across the product lifecycle (discovery, requirements, launch, iteration), ideally in compliance, tax-tech or fintech SaaS.**
* **Documentation: Clear PRDs, user stories, functional specs and test scenarios.**
* **Technical understanding: Working knowledge of APIs, integrations and ERP/accounting platforms; comfortable working with engineers.**
* **Data & communication: Uses data and customer insights to make decisions; communicates well across engineering, business, customer success and leadership.**
* **Prior experience in tax advisory, statutory audit, finance operations or enterprise compliance before transitioning into Product Management**

**Good to Have**

* **Experience building AI-enabled products or features, with an understanding of AI capabilities and their application in compliance and finance workflows.**
* **Experience working with enterprise customers and ERP ecosystems such as SAP, Oracle and Tally.**
* **Understanding of data security, privacy, regulatory compliance and enterprise SaaS requirements.**

 **Qualifications**

**Chartered Accountant (CA) with a passion for Product Management**

 **Additional Information**

**Job Location:** Procapitus Business Park, D Block, Sector 63, Noida  
**Type:** Permanent, Onsite (5 Days)

**Notice Period:** Immediate -30 days  
  
**Industry:** IT Product

**Mott MacDonald** is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy committed to delivering impactful work that shapes the future.

  

We are a team of over 20,000 experts working across the world in more than 50 countries.
  
We are proud to be part of an ever-changing global industry, delivering transformative work that’s defining our future. It’s our people who power that performance. As an employee-owned business, we invest in creating a space for everyone to feel safe and valued and empowered with the right tools and support.

Whether you want to pursue excellence in your specialism or broaden your experience with flexible roles across our business, you’ll be connected to a community of global experts championing you to be your best. Join us and shape your story with Mott MacDonald, where everyone has the opportunity to be **brilliant**.

**Job profile-**

We are looking for an experienced **Product Manager** to shape the next generation of our time-series data capability.

Across major infrastructure projects, large volumes of sensor, monitoring and operational data are generated over time. Our Timeseries product enables project teams to bring this information together, connect it with other project data, understand trends and changes, and build data-driven applications and services around it.

You will join our digital product and engineering organisation in India and work with colleagues and project teams around the world.

**Role description**

This is an opportunity to take ownership of a product at an important point in its evolution. We have an established legacy platform supporting real projects and customer use cases, alongside a new cloud-based Timeseries product that we are developing for the future.

Your role will be to understand how our customers and project teams use time-series data today, identify their most important needs, and translate those into a clear product strategy and roadmap for the new platform. Your job will not be to recreate the legacy system feature for feature. You will work with customers, project teams, engineers, architects and other Product Managers to determine:

* what should become part of the core Timeseries product;

* what should be redesigned or simplified;

* what should be enabled through APIs, events and integrations;

* how existing projects can safely transition to the new platform;

* and which legacy capabilities can ultimately be retired.

You will be comfortable working in a technically complex environment while keeping the product focused on user needs, reusable capabilities and measurable outcomes.

**Job Responsibilities** **-**

* Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for our Timeseries product.

* Understand how customers and project teams use time-series, sensor and operational data, and identify the problems that are most valuable for us to solve.

* Lead product discovery with users, project teams, engineers and subject-matter experts, translating their needs into clear product outcomes and priorities.

* Define MVPs and make deliberate decisions about what belongs in the core product and what does not.

* Work closely with the engineering team to maintain a clear, prioritised and delivery-ready product backlog, ensuring upcoming work is understood and aligned to product outcomes.

* Play an active role in the team's agile delivery rhythm, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives, maintaining clarity on priorities, outcomes and learning.

* Shape the product capabilities for ingesting, managing, finding, visualising and responding to time-series data, including ingestion, search and alarming.

* Define how Timeseries works with APIs, events and other applications so that specialist project needs don't create unnecessary complexity within the core product.

* Lead the product strategy for transitioning existing projects from our legacy platform, identifying what should be replaced, redesigned, supported differently or retired, and developing a repeatable migration approach.

* Improve onboarding and self-service so project teams can adopt and configure Timeseries without relying on specialist platform knowledge.

* Work closely with engineering, architecture, design and other product teams to turn product direction into delivered customer outcomes.

* Define meaningful measures of product adoption, customer value and migration progress.

* Communicate product direction, priorities, decisions and progress clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Candidate Specification**

We are looking for an experienced Product Manager who enjoys solving complex product problems and is comfortable working with technical products.

You may currently be working with a data platform, IoT product, analytics platform, developer platform, enterprise SaaS product or another technically complex B2B product.

You do not need to be a software engineer or database specialist. However, you should be technically curious and able to work confidently with engineers and architects, understand the implications of different approaches, and turn technical complexity into clear product decisions.

Most importantly, you will bring strong product judgement. You will be comfortable deciding not only what we should build, but also what we should not build.

Your experience is likely to include several of the following:

* Product strategy, discovery and roadmap ownership.

* B2B, enterprise, platform or data product management.

* Understanding customer and user problems through research and discovery.

* Translating complex needs into product outcomes rather than simply collecting feature requests.

* Defining MVPs and making evidence-based prioritisation and scope decisions.

* Working closely with engineering, architecture and design teams.

* APIs, integrations, data pipelines or other technically complex product capabilities.

* Cloud-based software products.

* Managing products with multiple customer or project use cases.

* Communicating complex product decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Experience leading or contributing to a legacy platform replacement, customer migration, data-platform migration or major product transformation would be particularly valuable.

**Qualifications Preferred** **-**

Experience in some of the following areas would be beneficial, but is not essential:

* time-series databases or time-series data products;

* IoT, sensors, telemetry or operational data;

* Microsoft Azure or other major cloud platforms;

* APIs and SDKs;

* event-driven systems;

* data ingestion and data pipelines;

* data visualisation and analytics;

* alerting or alarming products;

* geospatial or GIS products;

* multi-tenant SaaS or platform products.

We are more interested in finding an excellent Product Manager who is comfortable working with technical products, than somebody who already knows our particular technology stack.

**Further details-**

This role offers the opportunity to shape a product while it is being transformed rather than inheriting one where all the major product decisions have already been made.

You will help us take the best of an established capability, simplify areas that have become complex over time, and establish a modern Timeseries product that can support projects at scale.

You'll have the opportunity to work with real infrastructure use cases and diverse project teams, and to influence how sensor and operational data are used across our digital products in the future.

The successful candidate will ultimately help us answer three important questions:

* What should our Timeseries product become?

* How do we make it simple and valuable for projects to adopt?

* How do we successfully move from the platform we have today to the product we want for the future?

**Flexible working**
  
At Mott MacDonald, we support our staff to create work-life balance which works for them and welcome candidates looking for career flexibility. We are open to discussing flexible working at interview stage.

  

**Our benefits package is designed to enhance your experience:**

* Agile working
* Critical illness and compassionate leave
* Paternity Leave
* Group term life insurance, and Group medical insurance coverage
* Career mobility options
* Short and Long-term global employment opportunities
* Global collaboration and knowledge sharing
  

**Employment Compliance Requirement**

As part of our global compliance requirements, all candidates must hold a valid Right to Work (RTW) document in India, which will be verified during the recruitment process.
  
**Acceptable documents include a Passport, Voter ID, or Birth Certificate.**
  
By applying, you **confirm** that you can provide valid documentation if and when required.

title: Product Manager, Children
job_description:
Simon & Schuster is a global leader in general interest publishing, dedicated to providing the best in fiction and nonfiction for readers of all ages, and in all printed, digital, and audio formats. Its distinguished roster of authors includes many of the world’s most popular and widely recognized writers, and winners of the most prestigious literary honors and awards. It is home to numerous well-known imprints and divisions such as Simon & Schuster, Scribner, Atria Books, Gallery Books, Pocket Books, Adams Media, Simon & Schuster Children’s Publishing and Simon & Schuster Audio and international companies in Australia, Canada, India, and the United Kingdom, and proudly brings the works of its authors to readers in more than 200 countries and territories. For more information visit our website at www.simonandschuster.com.
  
  
The Job Profile
  
We have an exciting vacancy for a Product Manager, Childrens, to join our energetic Product India team.
  
Reporting to the Product & Procurement Director, the Product Manager, Childrens will be responsible for building and developing the children’s books portfolio for the India market. Children’s books represent an important growth opportunity across schools, parents, institutions, retail, online platforms and distribution channels.
  
The Job Role
  
The Product Manager will be responsible for developing and growing the children’s books portfolio for the Indian market by identifying and evaluating relevant titles from S&S UK, S&S US and client publishers. This will include managing the title pipeline, supporting list planning, pricing and positioning, identifying market opportunities, and providing product recommendations to distribution clients. Working closely with sales, marketing and distribution teams, the Product Manager will monitor market trends, competitor activity and customer demand, drive the visibility and performance of the children’s list, and develop a commercially attractive portfolio to support the company’s distribution growth strategy.
  
The Candidate Profile
  
The Product Manager will have a strong understanding of the children’s books market, excellent commercial, analytical and product selection skills, and the ability to identify new titles and market opportunities.
  
They will have experience in product management, publishing, editorial, sales, category management or a related field, ideally within the children’s books, education, retail or e-commerce sectors. Experience in book selection, list planning and working with publishers, distributors or international publishing organisations would be an advantage. Strong communication and relationship-building skills, attention to detail, proficiency in Microsoft Excel and the ability to manage multiple priorities are essential.
  
**Salary:** Competitive & Benefits
  
Please apply by attaching your CV and cover letter.
  
  
Simon & Schuster India is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). At Simon & Schuster India, the spirit of inclusion feeds into everything that we do. Simon & Schuster is a global leader in general interest publishing, dedicated to providing the best in fiction and nonfiction for readers of all ages, and in all printed, digital, and audio formats. Its distinguished roster of authors includes many of the world’s most popular and widely recognized writers, and winners of the most prestigious literary honors and awards. It is home to numerous well-known imprints and divisions such as Simon & Schuster, Scribner, Atria Books, Gallery Books, Pocket Books, Adams Media, Simon & Schuster Children’s Publishing and Simon & Schuster Audio and international companies in Australia, Canada, India, and the United Kingdom, and proudly brings the works of its authors to readers in more than 200 countries and territories. For more information visit our website at www.simonandschuster.com.
  
  
The Job Profile
  
We have an exciting vacancy for a Product Manager, Childrens, to join our energetic Product India team.
  
Reporting to the Product & Procurement Director, the Product Manager, Childrens will be responsible for building and developing the children’s books portfolio for the India market. Children’s books represent an important growth opportunity across schools, parents, institutions, retail, online platforms and distribution channels.
  
The Job Role
  
The Product Manager will be responsible for developing and growing the children’s books portfolio for the Indian market by identifying and evaluating relevant titles from S&S UK, S&S US and client publishers. This will include managing the title pipeline, supporting list planning, pricing and positioning, identifying market opportunities, and providing product recommendations to distribution clients. Working closely with sales, marketing and distribution teams, the Product Manager will monitor market trends, competitor activity and customer demand, drive the visibility and performance of the children’s list, and develop a commercially attractive portfolio to support the company’s distribution growth strategy.
  
The Candidate Profile
  
The Product Manager will have a strong understanding of the children’s books market, excellent commercial, analytical and product selection skills, and the ability to identify new titles and market opportunities.
  
They will have experience in product management, publishing, editorial, sales, category management or a related field, ideally within the children’s books, education, retail or e-commerce sectors. Experience in book selection, list planning and working with publishers, distributors or international publishing organisations would be an advantage. title: Regulatory Reporting Product Manager
job_description:
**About the Role:**
===================

**Grade Level (for internal use):**

10

**The Team:**

Cappitech S&P is a leading provider of regulatory reporting and compliance solutions for financial institutions. Its platform automates trade and transaction reporting across multiple jurisdictions, ensuring accuracy and reducing operational risk. By streamlining complex regulatory processes, Cappitech S&P helps firms stay compliant and adapt quickly to evolving industry standards. The company’s innovative approach has significantly improved transparency and efficiency in financial markets.

**The Impact:**

As a member of Product team, you will play an important role in continuing to make it all happen. You will be joining a team of problem solvers and solution finders with a passion for providing the very best customer experience in a fast-paced environment. We are a diverse team supporting our global customers. S&P values focus on inclusiveness, collaboration and integrity and our management strive to provide a work environment that encourages our colleagues to achieve their full potential.

**What’s in it for you:**

As the Regulatory Reporting Product Manager, you will work within the Cappitech Product Regulation Team. You will have full ownership on the product life cycle (market analysis, concept, requirement definition through launch) while interacting with internal stakeholders to ensure the successful launch on new functionalities and continually improving the entire client experience.

**Responsibilities:**

* Activities will include understanding regulatory requirements & translating those requirements into product features and system requirements, collaborating with the development teams and provide training and documentation internally to the Operational teams and externally to Customers.
* Gather and Analyze market requirements and offering
* Define Product requirements – from the high-level concept to detailed source mapping and functionality requirements
* Work with the Development and QA team to design and develop the solution to meet the business requirements
* Provide business, technical, and product knowledge in support of pre-sales activities in order to ensure customer satisfaction

**What We're looking for:**

Skill set and Knowledge:

Must have requirement

* Attention to detail
* Ability to read and understand regulatory documentation
* 6-8 years of experience in financial markets business or fintech
* Proactiveness in Identifying Risks, mitigating Risks and managing Project timeline.
* Previous hands-on experience in Derivatives regulatory reporting (JFSA, HKMA, EMIR Refit, ASIC, MAS, CFTC, SEC or Canada)
* A solid understanding of Derivatives Products such Swaps, Options & Forwards
* Building Requirement specifications and well versed with creating user stories in JIRAs
* Problem Solving Skills & Critical thinking abilities
* Building Requirement specifications and well versed with creating user stories in JIRAs
* Prior experience working with Development team
* Ability to reverse engineering
* Stakeholder management
* Excellent communication skills with ability to explain complex or unfamiliar concepts in simple terms.
* Problem Solving Skills
* Strong interpersonal skills
* SQL skills
* Able to work independently on multiple projects with minimal direction or supervision.
* Ability to work under pressure

**Good to have:**

* 4+ years in Product management

**About S&P Global Market Intelligence**  
  
At S&P Global Market Intelligence, a division of S&P Global we understand the importance of accurate, deep and insightful information. Our team of experts delivers unrivaled insights and leading data and technology solutions, partnering with customers to expand their perspective, operate with confidence, and make decisions with conviction.
  
  
For more information, visit www.spglobal.com/marketintelligence .

**What’s In It For** **You?**

**Our Mission:**

Advancing Essential Intelligence.

**Our People:**

We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We’re committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference.

**Our Values:**

**Integrity, Discovery, Partnership**

Throughout our history, the world's leading organizations have relied on us for the Essential Intelligence they need to make confident decisions about the road ahead. We start with a foundation of integrity in all we do, bring a spirit of discovery to our work, and collaborate in close partnership with each other and our customers to achieve shared goals.
  
  
**Benefits:**

We take care of you, so you can take care of business. We care about our people. That’s why we provide everything you—and your career—need to thrive at S&P Global.
  
  
Our benefits include:

* Health & Wellness: Health care coverage designed for the mind and body.
* Flexible Downtime: Generous time off helps keep you energized for your time on.
* Continuous Learning: Access a wealth of resources to grow your career and learn valuable new skills.
* Invest in Your Future: Secure your financial future through competitive pay, retirement planning, a continuing education program with a company-matched student loan contribution, and financial wellness programs.
* Family Friendly Perks: It’s not just about you. S&P Global has perks for your partners and little ones, too, with some best-in class benefits for families.
* Beyond the Basics: From retail discounts to referral incentive awards—small perks can make a big difference.

For more information on benefits by country visit: https://spgbenefits.com/benefit-summaries

**Global Hiring and Opportunity at S&P Global:**

At S&P Global, we are committed to fostering a connected and engaged workplace where all individuals have access to opportunities based on their skills, experience, and contributions. Our hiring practices emphasize fairness, transparency, and merit, ensuring that we attract and retain top talent. By valuing different perspectives and promoting a culture of respect and collaboration, we drive innovation and power global markets.

**Recruitment Fraud Alert:**

If you receive an email from a spglobalind.com domain or any other regionally based domains, it is a scam and should be reported to reportfraud@spglobal.com . S&P Global never requires any candidate to pay money for job applications, interviews, offer letters, “pre-employment training” or for equipment/delivery of equipment. Stay informed and protect yourself from recruitment fraud by reviewing our guidelines, fraudulent domains, and how to report suspicious activity here .

-

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

S&P Global is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, marital status, military veteran status, unemployment status, or any other status protected by law. Only electronic job submissions will be considered for employment.

  

If you need an accommodation during the application process due to a disability, please send an email to: EEO.Compliance@spglobal.com and your request will be forwarded to the appropriate person.
  
  
**US Candidates Only:** Know Your Rights: Workplace discrimination is illegal

Location: Sun House - Corporate Office

Group Product Manager (Rural Chronic)

**Business Unit:**

Alternate Channels

Sun House, Mumbai

  
  
  

At Sun Pharma, we commit to helping you **“Create your own sunshine”**— by fostering an environment where you grow at every step, take charge of your journey and thrive in a supportive community.

Are You Ready to Create Your Own Sunshine?

  

As you enter the Sun Pharma world, you’ll find yourself becoming ‘Better every day’ through continuous progress. Exhibit self-drive as you ‘Take charge’ and lead with confidence. Additionally, demonstrate a collaborative spirit, knowing that we ‘Thrive together’ and support each other’s journeys.”

  

**YOUR TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

  

* Development, collaboration, implementation, & accountability for strategic and operational plans which optimize profitability, market share, and revenue growth for a brand portfolio in the short and long term. Applicant to lead various assignments to help the BU meet overall BU business goals
* Development of marketing and promotional plans for products to support the end customers (Doctors) need
* Monitor business performance and support the portfolio with the help of regular tracking
* Market intelligence through primary research and customer connect of 2 weeks every month
* Writing and executing strategic business and marketing plans in collaboration with important prescribers, opinion leaders, round tables, and other advisory groups
* Joint financial responsibility for budgets (advertising and promotion, conferences and symposia, sales brochures and other product documentation, website content, literature), as well as analysis of budget income and costs;
* Initiating and coordinating marketing activities and projects
* Presentation to staff and training field staff for the same
* Translating the corporate brand strategy in close collaboration with headquarters, together with logos and visuals, working with corporate product budgets (approval for expenditure on projects, local communication strategies), and providing input into corporate product strategy;
* Discussion partner for first, second, and third-line professionals such as general practitioners, medical specialists, pharmacists, and other medical professionals, and for other DMU members (decision-making units) such as local bodies/gram panchayats
* Organizing advisory councils, acting as a discussion leader or chairman, or giving product presentations.
* Collaboration with internal & external media to ensure the proper execution of strategies
* Rural data analysis

  

**Job Requirements**

  

**Educational Qualification**

B. Pharm / M. Pharm & MBA

  

**Experience**

8 years+ experience in Pharma Marketing

  

* Therapy exposure: candidate with experience in CVD therapy will be preferred
* Demonstrable success in marketing or sales
* Strategic insight
* Effective networking skills and planning ability
* Creativity and persuasiveness
* Analytical and conceptual strength
* Strong and inspiring personality
* Self-starting and entrepreneurial
  

**Your Success Matters to Us**

  

At Sun Pharma, your success and well-being are our top priorities! We provide robust benefits and opportunities to foster personal and professional growth. *Join us at Sun Pharma, where every day is an opportunity to grow, collaborate, and make a lasting impact. Let’s create a brighter future together!*

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
**Job Requirements**  

At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster.

**Key Responsibilities**  
As the Product Manager for P&DI for energy sector data products (specifically, areas like solar), you will own the product lifecycle of our offerings and also run program management across the product portfolio. Your responsibilities will be to:

* Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for relevant products, from opportunity discovery and business case through launch, scale-up and lifecycle management.
* Translate utility, C&I and consumer needs into clear problem statements, PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria, and prioritise the backlog against business value, effort and risk.
* Work closely with Engineering, Data Science, IoT/hardware, Design and Operations teams to deliver products on time and with high quality, running sprint planning, reviews and release readiness.
* Define pricing, packaging and go-to-market plans for new energy products in partnership with Sales, Marketing and Partnerships, and support pilots and early customer deployments.
* Define product KPIs and success metrics (adoption, energy savings, revenue, reliability, customer satisfaction), and use data and customer feedback to iterate on the product.
* Run program management across all P&DI products for energy: maintain an integrated plan of milestones, dependencies, risks and resourcing, and drive cross-functional alignment on timelines and scope.
* Set up and run a consistent program governance rhythm, including status reporting, risk and issue escalation, change control and steering reviews with senior leadership.
* Track budgets, vendor and partner deliverables, and compliance with regulatory, security, data privacy and enterprise standards across programs.
* Conduct market, competitor and regulatory research in the energy sector (solar, storage, EV charging, smart metering, demand response, energy analytics) to shape product direction.
* Build reusable product and program playbooks, templates and tools that improve predictability and speed across teams.
* Communicate clearly with senior stakeholders, customers and partners, and act as a thought partner who challenges assumptions and adapts priorities as needs change.

Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related field from a reputed university. An MBA or advanced degree will be an added advantage.
* 4–6 years of experience in product management, with at least 1–2 years running multi-team programs or projects, preferably in energy, utilities, IoT, cleantech or B2B technology.
* Proven track record of taking a product from concept to launch and scale, including writing PRDs, managing backlogs and working in agile teams.
* Strong program management skills: planning, dependency and risk management, stakeholder governance and delivery tracking across multiple concurrent initiatives.
* Good understanding of the energy value chain and technologies such as solar, battery storage, EV charging, smart meters, and energy management or analytics platforms.
* Working knowledge of IoT and data-driven products, including APIs, platform architecture, dashboards and analytics, with the ability to engage credibly with engineering teams.
* Ability to build business cases, pricing models and financial plans, and to define and track product metrics using data (SQL, BI tools or similar).
* Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, MS Project or equivalent, and with product and prototyping tools such as Figma.
* Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.

We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard.

We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21,000 difference-makers in our workplace.

***Where will your career take you next? Let’s find out together.***

  

At Zurich Cover-More, we’re proud to be one of the world’s leading travel insurance and assistance providers*.* Each year, we protect more than 20 million travellers worldwide, making sure we’re there every step of their journey with proactive care, personalised cover and specialist support. Zurich Cover-More partners with many of the world’s best-known brands – think major airlines, travel giants, top banks, credit card providers, and large retailers – to deliver more care, more cover, for all.

  

Launched in December 2024, Zurich Cover-More is the global travel brand of Zurich Insurance Group, one of the world’s leading multi-line insurers. Our family of customer-facing brands includes trusted names like Travel Guard, Cover-More Travel Insurance, Travelex Insurance, Universal Assistance, World Travel Protection, Freely, and Blue Insurance. Together, we’re redefining what it means to travel safely and with confidence. Whether it’s a long-awaited holiday, a last-minute business trip, or an unexpected detour, we deliver in the moments that matter.

  

**About the opportunity:**

* Experience rolling out a shared platform across regions or business units
* Strong process design skills: BPMN, Lean, SLAs and work allocation
* Experience leading analysts and managing SI partners and vendors
* The credibility to bring operations and technology leaders to one plan

**Nice to have**

* Insurance claims, policy servicing or assistance operations experience
* Migration from legacy claims or case systems
* AI in operations: document intake, triage or agent assist
* Lean Six Sigma certification
* BPM platform or Scrum Product Owner certification
  

**Why you’ll love working with us!**

We value optimism, caring, togetherness, reliability, results-orientation, and forward-thinking.

  

We have more than 3000 employees worldwide. We are a global group of digital specialists, actuaries, marketers, doctors, nurses, case managers, claims specialists, finance experts, customer service and corporate services professionals. We share a global purpose to look after travellers, at every step of their journey.

  

**Job flexibility**. We understand the importance of making sure that work fits into your life, not the other way around. Our hybrid approach ensures you can maintain work-life balance with the flexibility of 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home, after an initial training period.

  

**Career growth**. This is an extremely exciting time for us at Zurich Cover-More, as we rapidly expand our business across the globe. title: Senior Product Manager - KYC Platform
job_description:
Senior Product Manager — KYC Platform
  
  
Build the onboarding backbone that powers every credit product PayU Finance owns.
  
  
ABOUT PAYU FINANCE INDIA
  
  
PayU Finance India Limited is one of India's fastest-growing digital lending businesses, operating at the intersection of payments, credit, and technology. Through our flagship consumer product LazyPay and a rapidly expanding suite of merchant lending solutions, we serve millions of Indians with instant, responsible credit — making financial access simple, fair, and digital-first.
  
  
We are building the credit infrastructure for the next 500 million Indians. As a regulated NBFC backed by Prosus, one of the world's largest technology investors, we combine the agility of a startup with the governance of a regulated financial institution. Our teams solve hard problems in underwriting, platform engineering, compliance, and product — at scale, in real time.
  
  
ABOUT THE ROLE
  
  
As the Senior Product Manager for KYC Platform at PayU Finance, you will own the end-to-end Know Your Customer (KYC) infrastructure that underpins every lending product we operate — LazyPay consumer credit, merchant lending, BNPL, co-lending, and future lines of business. This is a platform role, not a product feature role. You will think in systems: designing scalable, partner-agnostic KYC journeys that can be configured, extended, and reused across business units. You will work closely with Compliance, Legal, Engineering, Data, and external partners including KYC bureaus, video-KYC vendors, DigiLocker, UIDAI, and banking correspondents. You will set the gold standard for compliant, frictionless onboarding at PayU Finance.
  
  
WHAT YOU WILL DO
  
  
**Define and own the KYC Platform roadmap:** design a modular, API-first KYC platform that serves all internal business units as internal consumers — eliminating duplication and enabling faster product launches.
  
**Drive platform thinking:** abstract KYC flows into reusable components (identity verification, liveness, document parsing, de-dup, risk flagging) and define clear platform contracts for product teams to build on.
  
**Lead partner integration strategy:** evaluate, onboard, and manage integrations with KYC vendors (CKYC, video-KYC, DigiLocker, UIDAI, PAN validation, face-match), negotiate SLAs, and own fallback logic.
  
**Translate regulatory requirements into product specs:** work alongside Compliance and Legal to convert RBI, PMLA, and FATF guidelines into product requirements — including re-KYC cycles, audit trail design, and data retention policies.
  
**Build with data:** define KYC funnel metrics, drop-off analytics, and fraud signals. Use data to reduce onboarding friction while maintaining regulatory thresholds. Continuously A/B test and iterate on the onboarding journey.
  
**Enable developer experience:** define clear API specifications, documentation, and sandbox environments so product and engineering teams across PayU Finance can self-serve on KYC without ad-hoc requests.
  
**Plan for scale and longevity:** architect KYC flows that can handle 10x volume, support new product lines (UPI credit, co-lending, embedded finance), and adapt to evolving RBI regulations without re-engineering from scratch.
  
**Drive governance:** own the KYC health dashboard — approval rates, STP rates, failure categorisation, re-KYC compliance, audit readiness — and present to senior leadership and regulators.
  
  
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
  
  
**Platform product experience:** 6–9 years in product management with at least 2–3 years owning a platform or infrastructure product — ideally in fintech, payments, or financial services.
  
**Regulated entity experience:** hands-on experience working within an RBI-regulated NBFC, bank, or payment aggregator — you understand what compliance means when there is a penalty for getting it wrong.
  
**Technical depth:** you can read API documentation, review a system design, and hold your own in an engineering discussion. You understand OAuth flows, webhook architectures, and data pipelines.
  
**Data-driven mindset:** you define success with metrics before you build. You are comfortable running SQL queries, interpreting funnel analytics, and building the business case from data.
  
**Partner management:** you have experience evaluating and onboarding third-party vendors, writing integration requirement documents, and managing SLA accountability.
  
**Long-term systems thinking:** you do not build for the next quarter — you design for the next three years. You document architectural decisions and think about backward compatibility, versioning, and deprecation.
  
**Communication:** you can write a one-pager that makes a compliance officer and an engineer agree on priorities. You communicate clearly, escalate appropriately, and drive alignment without authority.
  
  
GOOD TO HAVE
  
  
Experience in KYC/AML domain — CKYC, V-CIP, DigiLocker, UIDAI API integrations
  
**Knowledge of lending workflows:** loan origination, credit bureau pulls, underwriting triggers
  
Exposure to co-lending or white-label lending platforms
  
Familiarity with PMLA, RBI Master Directions on KYC (2016, as updated), and FATF guidelines
  
Experience with identity fraud detection, liveness check providers, or device intelligence
  
  
WHY PAYU FINANCE?
  
  
Own a platform product that will directly power India's next wave of digital credit — from consumer to merchant to embedded finance
  
Work at the intersection of product, compliance, and engineering in one of India's most complex regulatory environments
  
Build from the ground up — this role has significant greenfield opportunity to set the architecture, not just maintain it
  
Be part of a Prosus-backed, profitable business with the scale of a large company and the decision-making speed of a startup

**Job Title: Associate Product Manager / Product Manager – Airpay Money & Airpay Capital**   
**Job Level: APM / PM Report to: Senior Product Manager**   
**Department: Product**   
**Organization: Airpay Payment Services Pvt. Ltd (https://www.airpay.co.in/)**  
**Location: Mumbai**

Key Responsibilities:

* Own product features and roadmap initiatives across Payment Gateway (PG), QR Payments and POS solutions.

* Understand merchant and customer requirements and translate them into PRDs, user stories and functional specifications.

* Improve payment journeys, including merchant onboarding, payment acceptance, transaction status, refunds, settlements and reconciliation.

* Work closely with engineering, design, QA and business teams to deliver features from planning through launch.

* Manage integrations with banks, payment networks, processors and other technology partners.

* Track product performance using metrics such as transaction success rate, payment conversion, adoption, failure rates and merchant experience.

* Analyse product data and customer feedback to identify improvement opportunities and prioritise features.

* Coordinate with risk, compliance and operations teams to support secure and compliant payment experiences.

* Manage production issues and work with relevant teams to ensure timely resolution.

* Track competitors and payment industry trends to identify new product opportunities.

Required Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business, Finance or a related field; MBA preferred.

* 1–5 years of experience in Product Management (APM: 1–3 years; PM: 3–5 years).

* Relevant hands-on product experience in Payment Gateway (PG), QR Payments or POS is mandatory.

* Experience working on payment products, merchant payment acceptance or payment processing solutions.

Pay: ₹782,000.00 - ₹1,440,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Provident Fund
