author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Technical Product Manager
job_description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

The Senior Technical Product Manager (TPM) for CareSelect Imaging is responsible for translating product strategy, customer needs, and business priorities into clear, executable technical work and driving that work through successful delivery.

This role serves as a critical connection point between Product Management and Engineering, partnering closely with development teams in India and the U.S., as well as Architecture, QA, Operations, Support, and other cross-functional stakeholders. The Senior TPM must be able to understand the intended business and customer outcome, translate that need into manageable technical capabilities, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria, and remain actively engaged through planning, development, testing, release, and post-release validation.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical understanding with disciplined product execution. This individual does not need to be the solution architect or engineering lead, but must be technically fluent enough to understand system interactions, integrations, APIs, data flows, dependencies, and technical constraints; ask the right questions; challenge assumptions; and facilitate alignment between business and technical teams.

A key measure of success in this role is the ability to turn complex or sometimes ambiguous business needs into well-understood, appropriately scoped work that engineering teams can execute predictably.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Translate strategy into executable work: Partner with Product Management to translate business, customer, and product needs into well-defined capabilities, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized technical work
* Own backlog readiness and work decomposition: Break complex initiatives into manageable increments, maintain a healthy and prioritized backlog, and ensure work is sufficiently defined and understood before entering development
* Partner closely with Engineering: Work day-to-day with onshore and offshore Engineering, Architecture, and QA teams to clarify requirements, evaluate technical approaches, understand APIs, integrations, data flows, and dependencies, and resolve questions throughout development
* Drive delivery across teams: Support sprint and PI planning, coordinate cross-team dependencies, and proactively manage scope, risks, blockers, and decisions from initial definition through development and delivery
* Ensure quality and release readiness: Partner with Engineering and QA on testing, acceptance criteria, UAT, release readiness, and deployment activities, ensuring product changes meet intended business and customer outcomes
* Communicate and continuously improve: Provide clear visibility into priorities, progress, risks, dependencies, and release impacts while identifying opportunities to improve requirements quality, delivery predictability, and collaboration across distributed teams
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience
* 3+ years of experience in technical product management, product ownership, product management, business systems analysis, or technology delivery
* Experience working directly with engineering leadership, architects, and distributed development teams
* Experience supporting PI planning, dependency management, and scaled Agile delivery
* Experience managing and prioritizing backlogs in an Agile product-development environment
* Experience partnering directly with engineering teams to clarify requirements and drive work through planning and delivery
* Experience with Agile and portfolio-management tools such as Aha, Rally, Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar tools
* Demonstrated experience decomposing complex capabilities or features into clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria
* Demonstrated ability to influence technical decisions and drive alignment across multiple engineering teams
* Demonstrated ability to understand and communicate end-to-end technical concepts, including data flows, APIs, integrations, cloud platforms, or enterprise systems
* Demonstrated solid facilitation, written communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills
* Demonstrated ability to manage ambiguity, competing priorities, cross-team dependencies, and delivery risks

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with healthcare technology, healthcare payer operations, claims, prior authorization, clinical data, or managed-service platforms
* Experience operating within a scaled Agile or PI-planning environment
* Knowledge of cloud technologies, DevOps practices, integration testing, and automation
* Familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards such as HL7 or FHI

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

**Senior Product Manager**

*Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India*

**Come thrive at Tandems!** At Tandems, we’re reimagining the future of financial advice. We empower financial advisors to deliver smarter, more human guidance by combining data, empathy, and artificial intelligence. Partnering with leading financial institutions, we deploy intelligent software and AI to enhance advisor productivity and deepen client relationships - enabling firms to deliver personalized advice at unprecedented scale.

After building one of the industry’s leading Digital Wealth platforms, we’ve evolved. Today, Tandems is an AI-first company, building intelligent tools that help advisors run better meetings, anticipate client needs, and make more informed decisions. Our solutions are trusted by some of the world’s largest and most innovative financial institutions, including Wells Fargo, New York Life, Wells Fargo, Scotiabank, and Citizens.

  

**About the Team and Opportunity**

As a Senior Product Manager at Tandems, you will help lead Tandems’ next chapter by embedding AI thinking and capabilities across our suite of products and shaping how financial advisors work in the age of intelligence.

This is a high-impact, cross-functional role at the heart of Tandems’ transformation. You’ll work closely with Engineering, Data Science, Design, Research, and Business stakeholders to define and deliver products that blend machine learning, behavioral insights, and human-centered design.

You’ll drive innovation not only within a specific product area but also across the company, influencing how we conceptualize and integrate AI across our ecosystem, from advisor tools to client engagement and portfolio management experiences.

### **Why Work for Us**

* As a reliable and trusted financial solutions provider with expanding reach to 1 in 3 households nationwide, we believe it takes extraordinary people to disrupt decades of legacy financial practices to reimagine solutions that serve customers at scale.
* We are 100+ employees strong and steadily building. Our world-class team is growing with an industry-savvy board and strategic executive team guiding us forward.
* We offer competitive benefits that include Flexible PTO, Wellness benefit, Mobile/Internet subsidy, Employee Recognition Programs, and more!
* We are a remote-first company! We have regional hubs nationwide, with presence in 4 Countries: United States, Canada, India, and Singapore.
* We believe that one size fits one and embrace a culture that honors and celebrates diversity of backgrounds, approaches and experiences.
* We are guided by our core values: Customer Delight, Make It Happen, Think Big, and We Over Me. Read more about our core values and how we live them every day on our website here.

### **How You’ll Make an Impact**

* **Shape the AI vision for advisor success:** Lead the roadmap for products that use intelligence and automation to transform the financial advice industry.
* **Infuse AI across Tandems’ ecosystem:** Partner with other Product, Engineering, and Data Science leaders to define how AI enhances user experiences and outcomes across all existing and future products.
* **Translate intelligence into action:** Work with data scientists to turn model outputs into intuitive product experiences that create measurable real-world value.
* **Champion responsible AI:** Define and advocate for principles around transparency, fairness, and explainability in every product we build.
* **Experiment and iterate:** Use data and user feedback to drive hypotheses, run experiments, and evolve features that deliver measurable advisor and business impact.
* **Collaborate broadly:** Partner across design, marketing, and customer success to ensure product experiences are cohesive, valuable, and aligned with Tandems’ mission.

### **Ideal Person for this Role**

* **5–10+ years** in a product-focused role, ideally building and shipping enterprise, B2B, or platform products at scale.
* **Systems thinker** with the ability to understand how product decisions influence data flows, adjacent teams, and end-to-end user journeys.
* **AI-curious and fluent**, comfortable discussing models, ML-driven UX patterns, and data-powered product experiences (no coding required).
* **Human-centered mindset** grounded in empathy, user research, and designing technology that enhances—not replaces—human expertise.
* **Strong analytical and research skills**, leveraging both qualitative and quantitative insights to prioritize effectively and measure impact.
* **Execution excellence**, with a track record of balancing strategy and detail, making tradeoffs, and delivering in fast-moving environments.
* **Technical curiosity,** able to dive into data models, APIs, and system architecture to understand how intelligence becomes value.
* **Data-driven and outcome-oriented**, using metrics, experimentation, and evidence to drive decisions.
* **Collaborative leadership**, with extensive experience influencing and partnering across engineering, design, data, sales, marketing, and operations.
* **Exceptional communication skills** and the ability to work effectively with remote or distributed teams; FinTech or startup experience is a plus.

### **Perks and Benefits**

* Tax-friendly Compensation
* Liberal Leave Policy
* Medical cover for the family, including parents
* Quarterly Wellness Benefit
* WFH Allowance
* Mobile/Internet subsidy (for smooth WFH experience)
* Employee Referral Program
* Employee Recognition Program
* And more!

Tandems is backed by premier venture capital firms, including Bain Capital Ventures, General Atlantic, Nyca Partners, and Union Square Ventures as well as leading financial institutions including Wells Fargo, UBS, Santander, New York Life, and Comerica. We've raised over $100 million to support our growth as a leading technology provider to financial institutions.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We encourage people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives to apply.***

***San Francisco Applicants: Tandems will consider applicants with arrest and conviction records (criminal histories) in a manner consistent with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.***

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
Why N-able:

At N-able, we’re not just helping businesses be secure —we’re redefining what it means to be cyber resilient. Our end-to-end platform blends AI-powered capabilities and flexible tech stacks, so customers can manage, secure, and recover with confidence. But the real power behind it all? Our people. We’re a global crew of N-ablites, who love solving complex problems, sharing knowledge, and delivering solutions that actually make a difference. If you're into meaningful work, fast growth, and a team that’s got your back, you’ll be surrounded by people who believe in what they do—and in you.

What You'll Do:

We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to own a defined area spanning network discovery and asset monitoring, including its roadmap and delivery. Network discovery is about finding and mapping the devices and assets in a customer's environment. Asset monitoring covers monitoring for security, device health, and device observability. The two connect closely, since you can only monitor what you can see, but each is an area in its own right with its own problems, users, and roadmap. You'll work with the guidance of a Principal PM or product leadership on strategy, and you'll be trusted to run day-to-day execution on your own.

N-able PMs are full-stack PMs. You'll partner closely with engineering on what gets built and why, but the job doesn't stop at the backlog. You're expected to understand how MSPs operate, how customer environments are built and monitored, the competitive landscape, and where the technology is heading, and to bring that into decisions others can act on. You'll regularly be in front of partners and customers.

Product areas at N-able are flexible. As priorities and the market evolve, the areas our PMs own can change, and your focus may shift or broaden over time. We're looking for someone who sees that as an opportunity to grow.

  

* Own the roadmap and delivery for your area across network discovery and asset monitoring, contributing to its strategy and covering the lifecycle from discovery to launch.
* Translate MSP problems around device discovery, network visibility, security monitoring of assets, device health, observability, alerting, and noise reduction into clear product requirements, epics, and user stories, and explain the tradeoffs behind them.
* Make sure what gets discovered feeds what gets monitored, so that discovery and monitoring work as a coherent experience for the technician while each keeps its own roadmap.
* Partner day to day with engineering and architecture to deliver capabilities that measurably improve discovery coverage, monitoring coverage and accuracy, time to detect device issues, time to onboard, and technician efficiency.
* Run continuous discovery with MSP partners, internal IT teams, and prospects, separating what people ask for from what they actually need.
* Track the competitive landscape (RMM, network discovery and monitoring, asset monitoring, observability, ITOM) for your area and feed it into positioning and roadmap decisions.
* Build reliability, scalability, security, performance, and ease of use into product design, particularly for monitoring at scale across many customer environments.
* Define and track success metrics for your area, such as adoption, retention, and monitoring coverage, and act when they move the wrong way.
* Work with product marketing, sales, and support on launches, enablement, webinars, and analyst or customer briefings.
* Take on new or changing product areas as priorities shift, bringing your learning and good practice with you.
* Support and informally mentor newer product managers, sharing good practice with the team.

What You'll Bring:

* 7+ years in product management, including at least 2 years on SaaS products in IT management, network management, monitoring, or related infrastructure domains.
* Technical background in IT infrastructure, endpoint, and network management technologies, and a strong understanding of how MSPs manage IT for their customers.
* Self-motivation and comfort with ambiguity and change. You can take a loosely defined problem, make decisions, communicate them, and follow through with moderate supervision, and you adapt well when your area of focus shifts.
* Strong product sense: good instincts for what to build, what to cut, and what "good" looks like for a technician managing many customer environments under time pressure.
* A track record of shipping SaaS products in an Agile/Scrum environment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and clear, professional communication with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Bachelor's degree; a Master's degree is preferred.

**Big Pluses**
--------------

* Hands-on experience with network discovery, network or asset monitoring, RMM, observability, or ITOM tools, as a product manager, practitioner, or administrator.
* Working knowledge of discovery and monitoring technologies (e.g., SNMP, WMI, flow data, topology mapping, asset inventory, agent-based and agentless monitoring, telemetry).
* Understanding of security monitoring of assets, such as configuration and patch posture, vulnerability exposure, or endpoint security signals.
* Direct experience managing and monitoring production infrastructure.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., Network+, CCNA, Security+) or a background in IT operations, network engineering, or security.
* Experience building AI-powered product capabilities, such as anomaly detection or intelligent alerting.

Purple Perks:

* Group Medical , Personal Accident & Term life coverage
* Generous PTO and observed holidays
* 2 Paid VoluNteer Days per year
* Employee Stock Purchase Program
* FuN-raising opportunities as part of our giving program
* N-ablite Learning – custom learning experience as part of our investment in you
* The Way We Work – our hybrid working model based on trust and flexibility

About N-able:

At N-able, our mission is to protect businesses against evolving cyberthreats with an end-to-end cyber resilience platform to manage, secure, and recover. Our scalable technology infrastructure includes AI-powered capabilities, market-leading third-party integrations, and the flexibility to employ technologies of choice—to transform workflows and deliver critical security outcomes. Our partner-first approach combines our products with experts, training, and peer-led events that empower our customers to be secure, resilient, and successful.

title: Senior Product Manager Disruption Management
job_description:
**Powering the agentic revolution in travel.** Sabre is an AI-native technology leader, backed by one of the world’s largest travel data clouds. Built on an open, modular, cloud-native architecture, Sabre serves as the backbone for both established leaders and bold, new disruptors, guiding them to the next age of travel retailing through intelligent, connected, and personalized experiences. With AI at its core and operating at unparalleled scale, Sabre transforms insights into innovation, empowering airlines, hoteliers, agencies and other partners to retail, distribute and fulfill travel worldwide.

**Role Overview**

  

This role will own the product vision for simplifying and automating how schedule changes are identified, evaluated, communicated, and resolved, helping airlines reduce manual servicing while delivering a better traveller experience.

The Senior Product Manager will work across airline operations, reservations, servicing, reaccommodation, notifications, digital channels, and partner ecosystems to build scalable capabilities that support airlines with different business models, workflows, and levels of automation.

  

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

**Product Strategy & Ownership**

  

Define how the product evolves from manual and rules-based servicing towards increasingly **automated, intelligent, and self-service schedule change management** .

* Translate airline operational challenges and traveller needs into clear product requirements, features, and measurable outcomes.
* Prioritise investments based on customer value, operational impact, strategic alignment, and technical feasibility.

**Schedule Change & Airline Servicing Expertise**

* Develop solutions covering the end-to-end schedule change lifecycle, including: Detection and classification of itinerary changes.Assessment of impacted passengers and itineraries.Airline policies and reaccommodation rules.Identification and presentation of alternative flights.Automated and agent-assisted reaccommodation.Traveller notification and acceptance.Digital self-service.Ticketing and servicing considerations.Handling of ancillary products and associated services.Interline and partner-airline scenarios.Exceptions requiring manual intervention.
* Ensure solutions can support different airline policies, thresholds, workflows, and customer servicing strategies.
* Partner with adjacent product areas such as **DCS, reservations, disruption management/IROPs, retailing, customer servicing, notifications, and airport solutions** .

**Customer & Market Leadership**

* Engage directly with airline customers to understand current workflows, pain points, requirements, and desired business outcomes.
* Serve as a product subject-matter expert in customer discussions, workshops, demonstrations, and roadmap reviews.
* Monitor airline industry trends and evolving expectations around automated servicing and traveller self-service.
* Balance individual airline requirements with the development of scalable product capabilities.

**Execution & Delivery**

* Work closely with engineering, architecture, UX, operations, and other product teams to translate strategy into executable product increments.
* Develop clear epics, requirements, acceptance criteria, and business priorities.
* Make product trade-offs across customer demand, technical complexity, operational risk, and strategic value.
* Manage dependencies with upstream and downstream airline systems and product teams.
* Partner with delivery teams throughout development, testing, rollout, and adoption.

**Commercial & Business Outcomes**

* Build business cases for product investment and clearly articulate expected customer and business value.
* Define and track product success measures such as: Schedule changes resolved automatically.Reduction in manual servicing.Traveller self-service adoption.Time to resolution.Contact-centre/agent workload reduction.Customer adoption and satisfaction.
* Support commercial teams with product positioning, customer proposals, and strategic opportunities.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Significant product management experience, preferably within **airline technology, travel technology, reservations, passenger servicing, disruption management, or airline operations** .
* Strong understanding of airline passenger servicing and itinerary management.
* Experience defining product strategy and managing complex, cross-functional roadmaps.
* Ability to translate complicated airline workflows and business rules into scalable technology solutions.
* Experience working with engineering and architecture teams on highly integrated enterprise products.
* Strong customer-facing skills, including discovery, workshops, requirements discussions, and executive presentations.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritise competing customer, commercial, operational, and technology requirements.
* Strong analytical skills and ability to use data and customer insights to guide product decisions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with airline reservations/PSS, schedule change, reaccommodation, IROPs, ticketing, or passenger servicing.
* Knowledge of airline distribution and servicing concepts, including PNRs, segments, ticketing and EMDs.
* Understanding of interline and codeshare servicing scenarios.
* Familiarity with modern airline retailing concepts, including **Offers and Orders** , would be beneficial.
* Experience building highly automated or rules-driven airline servicing products.
* Experience with airline digital self-service and customer notification journeys.
* Experience managing products operating at significant transaction scale and requiring high availability.

### **What Success Looks Like**

The successful candidate will make Schedule Change progressively simpler, more automated, and more customer-friendly.

They will help move airlines away from labour-intensive servicing towards capabilities that can intelligently identify impacted travellers, apply airline policies, offer appropriate alternatives, automate routine scenarios, enable traveller self-service, and direct agents towards the exceptions that genuinely require human intervention.

Ultimately, the role will deliver measurable value across three dimensions: better traveller experiences, lower airline servicing costs, and greater operational efficiency.

### **Ideal Candidate**

This person combines airline domain expertise, strong product leadership, and customer empathy. They are comfortable moving from a detailed conversation about servicing rules or reaccommodation logic to an executive discussion about automation, customer experience, revenue protection, and operating cost.

They don't simply manage a backlog. They understand the problem, define where the product should go, and bring customers, technology teams, and business stakeholders together to get there.

We will give careful consideration to your application and review your details against the position criteria. You will receive separate notification as your application progresses.

Please note that only candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the role will proceed in the selection process.

* Make product trade-offs across customer demand, technical complexity, operational risk, and strategic value.
* Manage dependencies with upstream and downstream airline systems and product teams.
* Partner with delivery teams throughout development, testing, rollout, and adoption.

**Commercial & Business Outcomes**

* Build business cases for product investment and clearly articulate expected customer and business value.
* Define and track product success measures such as: Schedule changes resolved automatically.Reduction in manual servicing.Traveller self-service adoption.Time to resolution.Contact-centre/agent workload reduction.Customer adoption and satisfaction.
* Support commercial teams with product positioning, customer proposals, and strategic opportunities.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Significant product management experience, preferably within **airline technology, travel technology, reservations, passenger servicing, disruption management, or airline operations** .
* Strong understanding of airline passenger servicing and itinerary management.
* Experience defining product strategy and managing complex, cross-functional roadmaps.
* Ability to translate complicated airline workflows and business rules into scalable technology solutions.
* Experience working with engineering and architecture teams on highly integrated enterprise products.
* Strong customer-facing skills, including discovery, workshops, requirements discussions, and executive presentations.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritise competing customer, commercial, operational, and technology requirements.
* Strong analytical skills and ability to use data and customer insights to guide product decisions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with airline reservations/PSS, schedule change, reaccommodation, IROPs, ticketing, or passenger servicing.
* Knowledge of airline distribution and servicing concepts, including PNRs, segments, ticketing and EMDs.
* Understanding of interline and codeshare servicing scenarios.
* Familiarity with modern airline retailing concepts, including **Offers and Orders** , would be beneficial.
* Experience building highly automated or rules-driven airline servicing products.
* Experience with airline digital self-service and customer notification journeys.
* Experience managing products operating at significant transaction scale and requiring high availability.

The successful candidate will make Schedule Change progressively simpler, more automated, and more customer-friendly.

They will help move airlines away from labour-intensive servicing towards capabilities that can intelligently identify impacted travellers, apply airline policies, offer appropriate alternatives, automate routine scenarios, enable traveller self-service, and direct agents towards the exceptions that genuinely require human intervention.

Ultimately, the role will deliver measurable value across three dimensions: better traveller experiences, lower airline servicing costs, and greater operational efficiency.

This person combines airline domain expertise, strong product leadership, and customer empathy. They don't simply manage a backlog. They understand the problem, define where the product should go, and bring customers, technology teams, and business stakeholders together to get there.

job_description:
**Job Description:**

The **Senior Product Manager, Data Ingestion and Customer Onboardin**g is responsible for defining the strategy, roadmap, and execution of Vertex's data ingestion and customer onboarding capabilities. This role owns how customer data is collected, transformed, validated, and activated across Vertex products, ensuring customers achieve value quickly and efficiently. Working cross-functionally with Product Management, Engineering, Design, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Partner teams, this role delivers scalable solutions that improve customer adoption, reduce onboarding complexity, and strengthen platform data capabilities.

* Define and own product vision, strategy, and roadmap for data ingestion and customer onboarding; align priorities with company objectives, customer needs, and platform strategy while balancing strategic investments, customer commitments, and technical debt.
* Own the end-to-end customer onboarding experience from initial setup through successful product adoption; identify friction points, drive improvements that reduce implementation effort, and define success metrics for adoption, activation, and customer health.
* Define capabilities for data ingestion, mapping, validation, transformation, monitoring, and governance; understand integration technologies including APIs, connectors, and ETL/ELT processes to deliver scalable, reusable ingestion services and onboarding automation.
* Translate business requirements into detailed product requirements, user stories, epics, and acceptance criteria; manage and prioritize the product backlog and partner with Engineering through the full development lifecycle, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, and release planning.
* Collaborate with Professional Services, Customer Success, and Support teams to continuously improve onboarding outcomes and reduce operational overhead; partner with platform teams to deliver automation and reusable onboarding solutions.
* Engage directly with customers through interviews, workshops, and strategic discussions; demonstrate product capabilities to customers, prospects, and partners; communicate roadmap updates and product outcomes to leadership and cross-functional teams.
* Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and Engineering teams; build and maintain alignment across Product, Engineering, Design, Customer Success, and Partner organizations.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of product management experience in a SaaS, enterprise software, platform, or data-centric environment.
* Demonstrated experience building and managing product roadmaps; ability to evaluate trade-offs, assess technical constraints, and prioritize across competing business and customer needs.
* Experience writing detailed product requirements, user stories, epics, and acceptance criteria; hands-on proficiency with Agile methodologies and tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps.
* Working knowledge of data integration concepts including APIs, connectors, and ETL/ELT processes; ability to engage credibly with Engineering teams on data ingestion and platform integration topics.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; demonstrated ability to evaluate complex trade-offs and make prioritization decisions grounded in data and customer impact.
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to present priorities, roadmap decisions, and product outcomes clearly to both technical and executive audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across Engineering, Design, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Product organizations to deliver cross-functional outcomes.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience designing and improving customer onboarding workflows and implementation experiences, including customer journey mapping, implementation patterns, and time-to-value optimization.
* Familiarity with enterprise software ecosystems such as ERP, CRM, eCommerce, procurement, or finance platforms and their integration patterns with data platforms.
* Knowledge of data governance, data quality, and observability concepts; experience defining approaches for handling data exceptions and ensuring ingestion reliability.
* Experience with cloud-based platforms and modern SaaS architectures; understanding of scalable data platform and service design.
* Experience supporting customer demonstrations, workshops, and enterprise implementation engagements.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field; equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant professional experience accepted in lieu of a formal degree.

**COMMENTS:**

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals in this position. Other functions may be assigned, and management retains the right to add or change the duties at any time.

**Vertex Values: Together We Win**
==================================

We're building a team of people who are passionate about making an impact for our customers and committed to how that impact is achieved. Our values define the behaviors, mindset, and culture that make Vertex a great place to grow and do meaningful work.

**Play to Win or We Don't Play** — If we choose to do something, we're choosing to do it because we plan to win. That mindset raises our bar on product quality, customer outcomes, and how we show up for one another.

  

**Work As a Team, Putting the Customer At the Core** — Our customers are our true north. Whatever your role, ask: how will this help a customer succeed today? We earn trust through outcomes, not promises.

  

**Achieve Excellence With Integrity, Speed, and Agility** — The market isn't slowing down. We'll move faster, adapt quickly, and never compromise on doing things the right way — for teammates, customers, and partners.

  

**Innovate Boldly With a Growth Mindset** — Progress demands smart risk. We'll try new approaches, learn fast, and keep pushing the boundaries — especially where AI can remove friction and unlock value.

  

**Communicate with Care, Candor and Transparency** — Honest, constructive conversations make us better. Let's speak plainly about what's working and what isn't and help each other improve.

**Pay Transparency Statement:**

Annual Salary Range: ₹2,033,010.00 - ₹2,657,550.00

Pay Basis: Monthly

The expected base salary range for this role varies by location and is expressed in local currency. The posted range reflects the anticipated hiring range for successful candidates at the time of hire, based on relevant job‑related skills, experience, geographic location, and business needs. Base pay offered to new hires may vary within the posted range depending on individual qualifications and market considerations.

The posted salary range reflects compensation at the time of hire. Employees may experience additional compensation growth over time through performance‑based increases, expanded responsibilities, role progression, or internal career opportunities, in accordance with company policies and local practices.

In addition to base pay, this role may be eligible for other elements of Vertex’s total compensation package, which may include participation in the Vertex Bonus Plan (VOB), a role‑specific sales commission or bonus, and/or equity grants, where applicable.

Learn more about Life at Vertex and connect with your recruiter for more details regarding Vertex's compensation and benefit programs.

* *In all cases, compensation will comply with applicable local pay transparency and minimum wage requirements.*

job_description:
**Company Description**

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

 **Job Description**

Gracenote, a Nielsen company, is dedicated to connecting audiences to the entertainment they love, powering a better media future for all people. We are the content data business unit of Nielsen that powers innovative entertainment experiences for the world's leading media companies. Our entertainment metadata and connected IDs deliver advanced content navigation and discovery to connect consumers to the content they love and discover new ones.

Every day, Gracenote ingests data for over 100,000 channels and hundreds of streaming catalogs worldwide. It arrives through thousands of partner feeds covering linear schedules, streaming and VOD catalogs, and program metadata, in every format imaginable and changing constantly. That data powers entertainment discovery for the world's top cable, OTT, CE and digital clients, reaching hundreds of millions of consumers.

We are hiring a Sr. Product Manager II to own the Single Ingest Platform, the system that gets all of this data into Gracenote. Based in our Bengaluru engineering center, you will report to our Director of Product Management, Data Ingest and Delivery, and work alongside our Data Delivery Product Manager. Together you own how data enters and leaves our AI-driven metadata factory.

This is a software platform role, and the platform is a service. Teams downstream decide what to do with the data once it lands. Your job is to make sure every source is set up fast, every field we need is captured correctly, and every change reaches the platform in minutes. Speed and accuracy at scale are the whole game.

It is also a hands-on role. You will write specs yourself, work directly with engineers and Data Architects, and query the data to answer your own questions. We are looking for someone senior who still genuinely enjoys this work, and who sees AI as the way to run thousands of feeds without thousands of manual fixes.

Responsibilities

* Own the product vision, roadmap and delivery for the Single Ingest Platform across linear schedules, streaming and VOD catalogs, and every other source type our datasets depend on.
* Own the speed and accuracy of getting partner data into Gracenote, from onboarding new sources to processing every update.
* Drive AI innovation so ingest scales to new sources, markets and metadata types with greater speed and efficiency, without adding manual processes.
* Ensure the platform is monitored for performance and breaks, so issues are caught and resolved before they affect downstream teams.
* Run ingest as a service, translating the needs of Dataset Product Managers, metadata factory teams and Delivery into a prioritized roadmap.
* Define and publish the platform's service levels and key metrics for speed, accuracy, reliability and cost, and use them to drive decisions.
* Work effectively across a globally distributed organization, with strong async written communication, disciplined documentation, and willingness to flex hours for overlap with US and EU stakeholders.

 **Qualifications**

* 6+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years on platform, data or data integration products.
* Hands-on experience with data ingestion or integration at scale: onboarding external sources, handling format and schema changes, and monitoring data flows.
* Has applied AI or ML inside a product, not only for personal productivity. Examples include extraction, classification, anomaly detection or schema mapping. Can reason about confidence, error rates and when a human needs to step in.
* Actively uses LLMs in day-to-day product work to speed up analysis, automate repetitive PM tasks and make better decisions. Be prepared to walk through concrete examples in the interview.
* Demonstrated appetite for hands-on IC work at a senior level. Comfortable with XML, JSON, SQL and REST APIs, and able to write or LLM-assist your own Python or SQL scripts to answer product questions.
* Runs a product on a small set of input and output metrics, and delivers predictably against commitments in a structured, milestone-driven development process.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with a proven ability to influence stakeholders across geographies and time zones.
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Experience with TV and entertainment metadata, EPG data or content supply chains.
* Familiarity with industry metadata and feed standards such as CableLabs ADI, TV-Anytime, or MovieLabs MEC and Avails.
* Experience with near-real-time or event-driven data pipelines.
* Experience building partner-facing source specifications or self-service onboarding tools.
* Experience partnering with Data Architects to shape complex business data into coherent, extensible, scalable structures.

 **Additional Information**

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
**Overview:** Dozee Health AI is a pioneer in Contactless Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), proven to drive transformation at scale. Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, Dozee has emerged as India’s no. 1 RPM Company.

We are seeking visionary individuals to help us in this very exciting journey. As a part of our dynamic team, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with top healthcare providers in the country, applying AI-powered RPM solutions to tackle some of the most pressing challenges in healthcare - enhancing staff efficiency, improving patient outcomes, and pioneering the next generation of care models.

As our Senior Product Manager, you will be part of Dozee’s Product – Product Management team, owning  
Product Strategy & Vision, User Research & Problem Discovery and Product Execution & Delivery. It is a  
high-ownership role for someone who brings structure, quality and pace to everything they deliver, and  
who wants to help save lives with Health AI.

### **Responsibilities**

* Independently own product strategy for assigned products or modules, translating customer insights and business objectives into actionable roadmaps.
* Independently lead customer discovery, validate hypotheses, identify unmet needs, and converts insights into prioritised product opportunities.
* Manage end-to-end product releases, oversee dependencies, risks, timelines, and ensure successful product launches and iterations.
* Make product decisions using quantitative metrics, experimentation, customer behaviour, and business performance insights.
* Balance customer needs, technical constraints, and commercial priorities while solving complex product challenges and identifying new opportunities.
* Manage prioritisation across multiple product initiatives, balancing customer needs, engineering capacity, dependencies, and measurable business outcomes.
* Ensure compliance to and own the design and development SOPs.
* Ensure highest quality standards and seamless customer experience.

### **Requirements**

* 10+ years of relevant experience
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant discipline
* Anticipate customer challenges, identify unmet needs, and consistently advocates for customer value in product decisions.
* Navigate competing stakeholder priorities, facilitate complex discussions, and build alignment around product decisions.
* Independently evaluate complex product challenges, assess trade-offs, and make decisions balancing customer, technical, and business considerations.
* Demonstrate end-to-end accountability for product outcomes, release quality, stakeholder alignment, and achievement of product objectives.
* Mentor junior product team members, drive collaborative execution, and promote continuous learning and improvement within the product team.

### **Role Expectations**

* Lead complex deliverables or projects end-to-end and set the quality bar for the area.
* Translate team goals into clear plans and drive cross-functional collaboration.
* Mentor junior colleagues and share knowledge across the team.
* Use data to track progress and improve outcomes.
* Uphold Dozee’s values and quality-first culture in every deliverable.

**Vision & Mission**

**Save Million lives with Health AI**

Dozee is India’s leading AI-Powered **contactless Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM)** and **Early Warning System (EWS).** A solution that continuously monitors patients and provides early warnings of clinical deterioration, enabling timely interventions and enhancing patient safety in hospitals, nursing facilities and patient homes. A **"Made in India for the World"** solution, Dozee has pioneered the world’s first non-contact blood pressure monitoring system. Trusted by leading healthcare providers in India, the USA, and Africa, Dozee is transforming patient safety and care by enhancing outcomes and reducing costs.

Dozee is adopted by **300+ hospitals** and **monitors 16000+ beds across 4 countries**. Dozee has monitored over **1 Mn Patients,** Delivered **35000+ Life Saving Alerts** and Saved **10 Mn+ Nursing Hours.**

**Videos**

* Science Behind Dozee : Ballistocardiography & Artificial Intelligence

- 100 Dozee deliver 144 life saving alerts and INR 2.7 Cr of saving - Sattva Study

* Dozee saves life of a mother at home

* Leading Healthcare Game changers work with DozeeI

* Introducing Dozee VS

- Dozee Shravan - A clinical grade RPM service

**Dozee in News:**

**Bloomberg - Oct 21, 2024**

From AI Beds to Remote ICUs, Startups are plugging India's health Gaps

**News18Oct 26, 2024**

Now, You Can Remotely Monitor Your Loved Ones in Hospital With Bengaluru Start-Up's 'Shravan'

**Analytics India MagazineOct 29, 2024**

Dozee Harness AI for Personalised Patient Care

**ET HealthWorldSep 16, 2024**

We trust AI everyday - From Google Maps to Smartphones, So why not use it to enhance patient safety in healthcare?

**BW healthcareworldOct 29, 2024**

Dozee's AI-Powered System Predicts Patient Deterioration 16 Hours in Advance

A tertiary care hospital study published in **JMIR**, validated Dozee’s Early Warning System (EWS), showing it **identified 97% of deteriorating patients, provided alerts ~19 hours in advance**, and generated **5x fewer alerts,** reducing alarm fatigue and improving patient outcomes.

A study at King George Medical University, Lucknow, and published in **Frontiers in Medical Technology** demonstrated that Dozee’s automation can potentially save **2.5 hours of nursing time per shift**, improving workflow efficiency and allowing more focus on patient care.

A study on remote patient monitoring in general wards published in **Cureus** found that **90%+ of healthcare providers reported improved care** and patient safety, **74% of patients felt safer**, and there was a **43% increase in time for direct patient care.**

Research by **Sattva**, an independent consulting firm, demonstrates Dozee's substantial impact: for every 100 Dozee-connected beds, it can **save approximately 144 lives**, **reduce nurses’ time for vital checks by 80%**, and **decrease ICU average length of stay by 1.3 days.**

**Key Highlights**

* **Founded :** October, 2015

* **Founders :** Mudit Dandwate, Gaurav Parchani

* **Headquarters :** Bangalore, India | Houston, USA | Dubai, UAE

* **Key Investors & Backers :** Prime Ventures, 3one4 Capital, YourNest Capital, Gokul Rajaram, BIRAC (Department of Biotechnology, State Bank of India, and Dinesh Mody Ventures, Temasek Foundation, Horizons Ventures

* **Stage :** Series A+

* **Team Strength :** 280+

* **Business :** Providing Continuum of care with AI-powered contactless Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) and Early Warning System (EWS) for Hospitals and Home.

* **Certifications & Accreditations :** ISO13485:2016 Certified, ISO27001:2022 Certified, CDSCO Registered, FDA510K Cleared for the flagship product Dozee Vitals Signs (VS) measurement system and SOC2 Type II Certified

**Achievements:**

* Forbes India 30 under 30

* Forbes Asia 100 to Watch

**Overview:** Dozee Health AI is a pioneer in Contactless Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), proven to drive transformation at scale. Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, Dozee has emerged as India’s no. 1 RPM Company.

We are seeking visionary individuals to help us in this very exciting journey. As a part of our dynamic team, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with top healthcare providers in the country, applying AI-powered RPM solutions to tackle some of the most pressing challenges in healthcare - enhancing staff efficiency, improving patient outcomes, and pioneering the next generation of care models.

As our Senior Product Manager, you will be part of Dozee’s Product – Product Management team, owning  
Product Strategy & Vision, User Research & Problem Discovery and Product Execution & Delivery. It is a  
high-ownership role for someone who brings structure, quality and pace to everything they deliver, and  
who wants to help save lives with Health AI.

### **Responsibilities**

* Independently own product strategy for assigned products or modules, translating customer insights and business objectives into actionable roadmaps.
* Independently lead customer discovery, validate hypotheses, identify unmet needs, and converts insights into prioritised product opportunities.
* Manage end-to-end product releases, oversee dependencies, risks, timelines, and ensure successful product launches and iterations.
* Make product decisions using quantitative metrics, experimentation, customer behaviour, and business performance insights.
* Balance customer needs, technical constraints, and commercial priorities while solving complex product challenges and identifying new opportunities.
* Manage prioritisation across multiple product initiatives, balancing customer needs, engineering capacity, dependencies, and measurable business outcomes.
* Ensure compliance to and own the design and development SOPs.
* Ensure highest quality standards and seamless customer experience.

### **Requirements**

* 10+ years of relevant experience
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant discipline
* Anticipate customer challenges, identify unmet needs, and consistently advocates for customer value in product decisions.
* Navigate competing stakeholder priorities, facilitate complex discussions, and build alignment around product decisions.
* Independently evaluate complex product challenges, assess trade-offs, and make decisions balancing customer, technical, and business considerations.
* Demonstrate end-to-end accountability for product outcomes, release quality, stakeholder alignment, and achievement of product objectives.
* Mentor junior product team members, drive collaborative execution, and promote continuous learning and improvement within the product team.

### **Role Expectations**

* Lead complex deliverables or projects end-to-end and set the quality bar for the area.
* Translate team goals into clear plans and drive cross-functional collaboration.
* Mentor junior colleagues and share knowledge across the team.
* Use data to track progress and improve outcomes.
* Uphold Dozee’s values and quality-first culture in every deliverable.

**Vision & Mission**

**Save Million lives with Health AI**

Dozee is India’s leading AI-Powered **contactless Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM)** and **Early Warning System (EWS).** A solution that continuously monitors patients and provides early warnings of clinical deterioration, enabling timely interventions and enhancing patient safety in hospitals, nursing facilities and patient homes. A **"Made in India for the World"** solution, Dozee has pioneered the world’s first non-contact blood pressure monitoring system. Trusted by leading healthcare providers in India, the USA, and Africa, Dozee is transforming patient safety and care by enhancing outcomes and reducing costs.

Dozee is adopted by **300+ hospitals** and **monitors 16000+ beds across 4 countries**. Dozee has monitored over **1 Mn Patients,** Delivered **35000+ Life Saving Alerts** and Saved **10 Mn+ Nursing Hours.**

**Videos**

* Science Behind Dozee : Ballistocardiography & Artificial Intelligence

- 100 Dozee deliver 144 life saving alerts and INR 2.7 Cr of saving - Sattva Study

* Dozee saves life of a mother at home

* Leading Healthcare Game changers work with DozeeI

* Introducing Dozee VS

From AI Beds to Remote ICUs, Startups are plugging India's health Gaps

Now, You Can Remotely Monitor Your Loved Ones in Hospital With Bengaluru Start-Up's 'Shravan'

Dozee Harness AI for Personalised Patient Care

**ET HealthWorldSep 16, 2024**

We trust AI everyday - From Google Maps to Smartphones, So why not use it to enhance patient safety in healthcare?

**BW healthcareworldOct 29, 2024**

Dozee's AI-Powered System Predicts Patient Deterioration 16 Hours in Advance

A tertiary care hospital study published in **JMIR**, validated Dozee’s Early Warning System (EWS), showing it **identified 97% of deteriorating patients, provided alerts ~19 hours in advance**, and generated **5x fewer alerts,** reducing alarm fatigue and improving patient outcomes.

A study at King George Medical University, Lucknow, and published in **Frontiers in Medical Technology** demonstrated that Dozee’s automation can potentially save **2.5 hours of nursing time per shift**, improving workflow efficiency and allowing more focus on patient care.

A study on remote patient monitoring in general wards published in **Cureus** found that **90%+ of healthcare providers reported improved care** and patient safety, **74% of patients felt safer**, and there was a **43% increase in time for direct patient care.**

Research by **Sattva**, an independent consulting firm, demonstrates Dozee's substantial impact: for every 100 Dozee-connected beds, it can **save approximately 144 lives**, **reduce nurses’ time for vital checks by 80%**, and **decrease ICU average length of stay by 1.3 days.**

title: Senior Product Manager, Checkout
job_description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

**About the team and the role**
-------------------------------

The Checkout Experience team owns one of the most important moments in the buyer journey: helping customers complete their purchase with confidence, speed, and clarity. The space includes guest and member checkout, express payment experiences, checkout success, and key dependencies across cart, payments, shipping, and post-purchase experiences.

  
  

We are looking for a **Senior Product Manager** to lead complex, high-impact checkout initiatives that reduce friction, improve buyer trust, and unlock conversion at scale. In this role, you will define and drive multiple initiatives across the checkout funnel, influence cross-functional roadmaps, and help shape the future of Checkout Experience.

  
  

**What you will accomplish**
----------------------------

* Lead multiple Checkout Experience initiatives from discovery through launch and iteration.
* Identify the biggest sources of buyer friction and turn them into clear product priorities.
* Partner across Engineering, Design, Research, Analytics, and adjacent product teams to deliver measurable outcomes.
* Drive improvements across areas such as guest checkout, member checkout, express payments, delivery clarity, payment optimization, incentives, and checkout success.
* Use analytics, experimentation, and customer insights to make decisions and refine the roadmap.
* Influence cross-functional stakeholders and align teams around tradeoffs, sequencing, and success metrics.
* Contribute to the longer-term vision for checkout, including personalization, modernized flows, and AI-assisted experiences.
  

  

**What you will bring**
-----------------------

* Experience owning multiple customer-facing products or features end to end in a consumer, ecommerce, marketplace, or payments environment.
* 8+ years of relevant experience
* Strong product judgment and the ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear strategies and priorities.
* Comfort using data, experimentation, and customer insights to size opportunities and guide decisions.
* Ability to write clear product requirements with strong hypotheses, success metrics, and execution plans.
* Strong cross-functional leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
* Domain depth, or quickly demonstrated depth, in checkout, payments, buyer experience, ecommerce, or conversion optimization.
* A bias toward action, strong prioritization instincts, and the ability to operate with autonomy in a fast-moving environment.

**Additional Details**

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

  

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

Apply Now

Responsibilities:

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead product discovery sessions to understand business problems, customer needs, and outcome hypotheses.
* Support cross-functional teams including Product, Engineering, Development, Data, and Business partners in ideating and completing experiments.
* Capture, analyze, and communicate product insights, customer feedback, operational metrics, and measurable outcomes to collaborators.
* Maintain and share product health and operational metrics, ensuring progress toward product goals and objectives is clear and quantifiable.
* Collaborate with Product Managers and Agile teams to identify and resolve dependencies, impediments, and delivery risks.
* Act as or support the role of Product Manager by contributing to backlog management, story refinement, acceptance criteria definition, prioritization discussions, and sprint ceremonies.
* Communicate product releases, roadmap updates, experiment outcomes, and key product decisions to collaborators and partners.
* Work closely with business leaders, finance partners, and collaborators to support change readiness, product adoption, and business outcomes.
* Demonstrate strong communication, influencing, and relationship management skills while building connections across product teams.
* Leverage data, metrics, and analytical thinking to support data-driven decision-making and find opportunities for product improvement.

Continuously develop knowledge throughout all stages of the product lifecycle while contributing to an effective and mature product management practice.

Qualifications:

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's Degree or comparable experience.
* 6–10 years of overall professional experience.
* 5+ years of experience in Product Management, Business Analysis, or a related field within a highly collaborative, fast-paced environment.

Verified expertise in directing the product lifecycle and developing the roadmap.

* Experience working with product, engineering, and business collaborators.
* Experience leading multiple workloads and challenging priorities.
* Strong collaborator management, communication, facilitation, influencing, and negotiation skills.
* Demonstrated ability to bring to bear data and insights to drive business and product decisions.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience supporting benefits administration, Group Products, or related retirement-processing operations, particularly the administration of lump-sum and annuity benefits for traditional pension plans and Pension Risk Transfer arrangements.
* Working experience in Agile (Scrum/Kanban) environments.
* Practical experience working with Jira, Confluence, and Miro or similar tools.
* Exposure to end users, business collaborators, and technology teams.
* Understanding of Distribution in Life/Group Insurance would be a plus.

**Key Skills**

* Product Discovery & Experimentation
* Product Lifecycle Oversight
* Agile Delivery
* Collaborator Management
* Business Insight
* Prioritization & Decision Making
* Communication & Facilitation
* Influencing & Negotiation

----------------------------------------------

title: Senior Product Manager - Data Integrations
job_description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

* *Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.*

**An overview of this role**
----------------------------

As a Senior Product Manager for Data Integrations, you'll help GitLab's analytics and artificial intelligence (AI) agents see beyond the data held in GitLab. You'll decide which external systems connect to the Data Insights Platform and Orbit, which integrations come first, and how their data fits into shared models.

Engineering teams plan work, track incidents, monitor production, and manage security findings across different tools. Your challenge is to bring that context together with GitLab's code, merge requests, pipelines, deployments, and vulnerabilities. You'll shape a consistent approach that gives customers a trustworthy picture they can query, report on, and use with agents, rather than another set of disconnected data sources.

This role is based in Bangalore, India. You'll work from home and come to the Bangalore office when needed for business or team activities. You should be based in Bangalore or willing to relocate there.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Set integration priorities using evidence from customers, field teams, and other product managers to identify the biggest gaps in context.
* Shape how external data maps into GitLab's shared data models, including the extract, transform, and load (ETL) approach and the transformations needed to make sources work together.
* Define the customer problems and user groups each integration serves. Partner with engineering to agree on the intended experience, trade-offs, and delivery sequence.
* Translate product decisions into a clear backlog of epics and issues for engineering.
* Define telemetry and adoption signals to understand whether connected data helps customers answer new questions, and use those findings to guide priorities.
* Help shape integration pricing and packaging as the product area matures.
* Use AI coding agents and GitLab to explore data, prototype integrations, and document the intended experience.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* Product management experience, with the ability to connect customer needs to priorities and make trade-offs with incomplete information.
* Strong knowledge of the software development and operations (DevOps) ecosystem, including how planning, security, observability, and IT service management tools fit into engineering workflows.
* A working understanding of data integration, ETL, and data transformation, including how data from different systems maps to a common model. You don't need a background as a data engineer.
* Comfort using AI tools for prototyping and documentation as part of your product work.
* Clear communication about customer problems, close collaboration with engineering, and a habit of using data to evaluate adoption.
* Experience with integration products, data models, or value stream analytics is helpful, but isn't required.

**About the team**
------------------

We're part of GitLab's Core Data Products organization, which focuses on insights, analytics, and data-driven decision-making. You'll report to the Vice President of Product Management and join as our third product manager, focused on Data Integrations. You'll work alongside a Principal Product Manager responsible for the Data Insights Platform and dashboards, and a Product Manager focused on Orbit.

GitLab is all-remote, with asynchronous collaboration across regions. Transparency, written communication, and clear decisions are central to how we work. This role has the Bangalore location and in-person requirements described above.

#### **How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees**

* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

**Country Hiring Guidelines:** GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

**Privacy Policy:** Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
**About Tekion:**
-----------------

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

**What You’ll Do**
  
  

* Keep your integrations healthy and best-in-class: Define what “good” looks like for your integration pattern, measure it in our Integration Platform (Tekion’s internal health-monitoring system), and drive coverage, reliability, and quality up across all your integrations - benchmarking each against the best competing product in the market.

  

* Win on AI-powered delivery: Shift your pattern from hand-built integrations toward ones generated with Tekion’s AI-assisted build tools (internally, APC Studio), help sharpen the AI tools you depend on, and own a complete, living set of requirements that any engineering team can build from.

  

* Drive revenue through OEM certifications: Lead integration patterns toward successful OEM certification so OEM-approved integrations can be adopted by dealers at scale. Drive adoption and reduce support load: Make your integrations easy to install and switch on, raise dealership uptake where it is low, and reduce support tickets by tracking and fixing root causes.

  

* Partner across teams: Translate the needs of dealers, automakers, and partners into clear requirements, and work day-to-day with Engineering, Design, Support, and Go-to-Market teams to deliver, launch, and measure impact.

  
**What We’re Looking For**
  
  

* Around 5+ years of product management experience, or equivalent experience in a technical product, integration, API, or platform role. Strong early-career candidates with a technical background are encouraged to apply.

  

* Exposure to integrations, APIs, or platform and marketplace products, with the ability to read technical documentation and discuss APIs, webhooks, and data flows with engineers. (An API is a defined way for two systems to exchange data; a webhook is an automatic notification one system sends another when something happens. You do not need to write code.)

  

* A strong bias toward measurable outcomes, with comfort using dashboards, metrics, and data to set targets and track progress.

  
• Clear writing skills - the ability to turn messy, ambiguous requirements into crisp specifications and user stories. • Curiosity about AI and how it can automate technical work, plus the drive to improve the tools you use.
  
  

* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work with both technical and non-technical audiences.

  

* The ability to manage ambiguity, prioritize effectively, and make thoughtful trade-offs in a fast-paced environment.

  

* A bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  
**Nice to Have**
  
  

* Interest in or exposure to AI agents, large language models (LLMs), and automated workflows.

  

* Familiarity with the automotive retail world - dealerships, the Dealer Management System (DMS, the core software a dealership runs its business on), or automaker (OEM) certification programs.

  
**Why Join Us**  
  

* Modernize an industry: Help modernize how an entire industry connects its software, moving from slow, hand-built integrations to a fast, AI-powered delivery model.

  

* Work at the frontier of AI delivery: Be hands-on with how AI is used to scope, build, and test real enterprise integrations.

  

* See measurable impact: Own clear, measurable goals and watch your work show up directly in integration health, adoption, and support metrics.

  

* Grow with mentorship: Learn from senior product managers and engineers, with a clear path to grow into broader ownership.

  
Tekion is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

**Current Tekion Employees: Please apply via the Internal Job Board in Ashby.**

Note: Tekion recently transitioned to a new recruiting tool and we appreciate your patience and feedback as we adjust to our new system!

Tekion is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, victim of violence or having a family member who is a victim of violence, the intersectionality of two or more protected categories, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

For more information on our privacy practices, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice

***Important****: Tekion will only contact candidates from an @**tekion.com* *email address or through our applicant tracking system (no-reply@ashbyhq.com). We may also work with authorized recruiting partners from time to time. Tekion and its recruiting partners will never ask you to pay fees or send money for applications, interviews, training, or onboarding. If you receive a message that seems suspicious, please do not respond or share personal or financial information.*
