title: Senior Technical Product Manager (AI Agents) - Bengaluru
job_description:
We are looking for a technically strong Product Manager with hands-on experience building AI-powered products and agents. You will own product strategy, customer discovery and roadmap for enterprise AI applications, turning complex workflows into scalable, reusable product capabilities.

**Company Details**

Live2.ai is building an AI-native Social Content Intelligence Operating System for global consumer brands.

Its platform uses AI agents to monitor conversations, audit campaigns, analyse consumer behaviour, track influencers and turn social content into commerce. The product combines LLM orchestration, reasoning agents, multimodal AI and enterprise workflow automation.

Website: https://live2.ai/

**Requirements**

* 5+ years of Product Management experience, preferably in B2B SaaS, enterprise platforms or AI products.
* Mandatory hands-on product management experience with AI/LLM-powered applications or AI agents.
* Practical understanding of LLMs, prompting, RAG, tool calling, agent workflows and AI evaluation.
* Strong technical understanding of APIs, integrations, distributed systems and data architecture.
* Experience translating complex customer problems into product requirements and shipping products with cross-functional teams.
* Ability to distinguish reusable product capabilities from customer-specific customisations.
* Comfortable working directly with enterprise customers and technical teams.
* Willingness to work from the Bengaluru office.

**Responsibilities**

* Own product vision, strategy, roadmap and prioritisation for enterprise AI products and agent platforms.
* Drive customer discovery across enterprise customers and identify recurring workflow problems.
* Convert customer requirements into scalable product capabilities rather than one-off solutions.
* Define product experiences for building, configuring, testing, evaluating and improving AI agents.
* Work with AI and Engineering teams on tool calling, retrieval, model selection, guardrails and failure handling.
* Define success metrics for AI agents, including task completion, accuracy, reliability, latency and cost.
* Drive enterprise integrations, APIs, permissions, governance and platform readiness.
* Create PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria and release plans.
* Use prototypes and lightweight proofs of concept to validate product assumptions.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Design, AI, Sales, Solutions and Customer Success teams.
* Track product adoption, customer value, retention and platform scalability.

**Job Details**

Bengaluru, Work from Office

**Interview Process**

* Introductory Discussion
* Product & Technical Deep Dive
* Practical Product Exercise
* Founder Discussion

**Important Note**

ClanX is a recruitment partner, helping Live2.ai hire a Product Manager for its Enterprise AI Agents team.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Owner
job_description:
**About Vista Equity Partners**

Vista Equity Partners is a leading global investment firm focused exclusively on enterprise software, data, and technology-enabled businesses. With over $100B in assets under management and a portfolio of 90+ software product companies worldwide, Vista accelerates growth through operational excellence, shared expertise, and long-term partnership. In India, Vista’s presence continues to expand with 45+ portfolio companies employing more than 17,000 professionals across technology, product, customer success, and operations — reinforcing India’s strategic role as a hub of innovation and talent within the Vista ecosystem.

Through its Agentic AI Factory, Vista is embedding Generative AI across its global portfolio — enabling companies to integrate intelligent, responsible AI into products, operations, and decision-making. This initiative is strengthened through portfolio-wide learning programs, leadership workshops, and AI hackathons that foster innovation, build fluency, and accelerate practical AI adoption across teams.

**About Amtech**

Amtech is a leading provider of enterprise software solutions for the packaging, printing, and manufacturing industries. Our integrated systems streamline order management, production planning, scheduling, inventory, and business analytics — empowering customers to drive efficiency, reduce costs, and improve operational performance. With a strong commitment to innovation and customer success, Amtech delivers reliable technology backed by deep industry expertise.

With Vista’s investment and strategic guidance, we combine the agility of a growing technology organization with the scale, stability, and career mobility of a global software ecosystem.

**Our Employee Value Proposition**

At Amtech, our people are our greatest differentiator. We create an environment where you can:

**Purpose**

Shape the future of manufacturing and supply chain operations by delivering mission-critical enterprise software used by industry-leading organizations.

**Growth**

Access continuous learning, leadership development, and cross-portfolio opportunities through Vista’s global network — accelerating both technical and managerial career paths.

**Culture**

Work in a collaborative, transparent, and people-first environment where values, accountability, and integrity guide every decision.

**Innovation**

Engage with cutting-edge technologies, including AI-driven automation, and contribute to modernizing financial systems and operational processes across the business.

**Role Description**

We are looking for a Sr Product Owner, based in Amtech India, to support product execution for our labeling ERP product line and to coordinate and support the product owners working across our labeling and corrugated ERP product lines.

On the product side, this role performs the product-management execution work for the labeling line of business in close partnership with in-market product leadership. Working with product management and market-facing stakeholders, the Senior Product Owner translates roadmap initiatives and projects into actionable development work, produces and maintains product artifacts, and drives delivery — while market-facing direction, priorities, and customer strategy are set jointly with in-market leadership.

On the coordination side, this role supports and oversees the product-owner process for the India-based team: scheduling and facilitating agile ceremonies, acting as a quality gate on product development lifecycle (PDLC) artifacts, and building a strong product-owner community of practice. This is a coordination and enablement role; it does not carry direct people-management responsibility.

The ideal candidate understands manufacturing operations, ERP systems, and agile product development, and is comfortable working across technical teams, product owners, and in-market product leadership.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Product Execution (Labeling Product Line)**

* Perform product-management execution for the labeling product line in partnership with in-market product leadership.

* Translate roadmap initiatives and projects into epics, user stories, and a well-formed backlog.

* Produce and maintain product artifacts, working with in-market leadership to close market-facing gaps.

* Define and prioritize features, enhancements, and fixes in line with roadmap direction set with in-market leadership.

* Work with tech leads and development teams to plan sprints across multiple months.

**Product Owner Coordination & Enablement (Both Product Lines)**

* Coordinate and support the product owners working across the labeling and corrugated product lines in India.

* Schedule, facilitate, and oversee agile ceremonies — Program Increment (PI) Planning, Sprint Planning, and Sprint Reviews.

* Review and act as a quality gate on the completeness and quality of PDLC artifacts.

* Build and support a product-owner community of practice — shared standards, templates, and continuous improvement.

* Help product owners grow in their craft through coaching, feedback, and shared best practices.

**Agile Development Collaboration**

* Work closely with engineering, QA, UX, and architecture teams during sprint planning, development, and release cycles.

* Coordinate with product managers, tech leads, and development teams in Program Increment planning.

* Participate in sprint ceremonies including planning, reviews, and retrospectives.

* Clarify requirements and ensure development teams understand the desired product outcomes.

**Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Work with in-market product leadership (product management and market-facing stakeholders) to align execution with roadmap and customer needs.

* Work with implementation, support, and sales teams to ensure product features align with customer needs.

* Provide product expertise for internal stakeholders and help drive continuous improvement of product capabilities.

**SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS**

* 7+ years experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or Business Analyst in a software environment, including experience leading or coordinating other product owners.

* Strong experience working in Agile / Scrum development environments and facilitating agile ceremonies, including PI planning.

* Experience with ERP systems.

* Strong experience managing product backlogs, writing user stories, and defining and reviewing product requirements.

* Demonstrated ability to set and uphold quality standards for product artifacts.

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including working with distributed and in-market teams.

* Product backlog and requirements management

* Agile / Scrum facilitation and PI planning

* Product-owner coordination and enablement

* PDLC artifact quality and standards

* Stakeholder communication across distributed teams

* ERP / manufacturing domain

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience with manufacturing, ERP, or scheduling applications.

* Knowledge of production operations, shop floor workflows, or manufacturing analytics.

* Experience working in a distributed / offshore model in partnership with in-market product leadership.

* Experience establishing or supporting a product-owner community of practice.
* Experience with tools such as Jira or similar backlog management systems.

**Why Join Amtech**

At Amtech, you will drive meaningful financial impact in a growing enterprise software organization while benefiting from Vista’s world-class ecosystem. You’ll collaborate with talented peers, leverage cross-portfolio learning programs, and help shape the future of Amtech’s financial operations and systems. Build your career with Amtech — backed by the strength, scale, and innovation culture of Vista.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager, Growth
job_description:
**Who we are:**

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

**About the Role**

As Senior Product Manager, SaaS Growth, you will own product initiatives that improve customer acquisition, activation, conversion, retention, and expansion across Motive's Workforce Management suite of products. You will develop a deep understanding of customer needs, market dynamics, and business opportunities, then translate those insights into a focused product strategy and roadmap. You will work closely with engineering, design, marketing, sales, and customer teams to deliver measurable business and customer outcomes.

This role is ideal for a product leader who combines strong customer empathy with analytical rigor, moves comfortably between strategy and execution, and thrives in a fast-growing environment. You will have the opportunity to shape growth experiences, test new ideas, and help scale products that serve the people who run physical operations.

  

**What You'll Do**

* Define and execute the Workforce product growth product strategy across acquisition, activation, conversion, retention, and expansion.
* Own the roadmap for growth initiatives by prioritizing opportunities based on customer needs, business impact, data, and technical feasibility.
* Lead customer discovery, market research, and competitive analysis to identify high-value growth opportunities.
* Partner with engineering and design to deliver intuitive product experiences through rapid, iterative experimentation.
* Establish success metrics, analyze product performance, and use insights to improve growth outcomes.

**What We're Looking For**

* 5+ years of experience in Product Management, including experience owning SaaS, growth, or commercially successful software products.
* Demonstrated ability to formulate, prioritize, and execute product roadmaps in partnership with engineering and design.
* Strong analytical skills and experience using qualitative and quantitative data to guide product decisions.
* Deep customer empathy and the ability to translate complex customer problems into simple, compelling product experiences.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to build alignment across cross-functional teams.

*Creating a diverse and inclusive workplace is one of Motive's core values. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives.*

*Please review our Candidate Privacy Notice* *here**.*

*UK Candidate Privacy Notice* *here**.*

*The applicant must be authorized to receive and access those commodities and technologies controlled under U.S. Export Administration Regulations.* *It is Motive's policy to require that employees be authorized to receive access to Motive products and technology.*

*Regarding US-based roles, depending on your role and primary work location, Motive Technologies, Inc. ("Employer") discloses candidates may be required to execute a non-compete covenant with the Employer. This requirement does not apply to lawyers, interns, or employees working in CA, MN, MT, ND, OK, or where otherwise prohibited by law.*

*Non-compete covenant terms in all other jurisdictions will be subject to the applicable statutory requirements, including but not limited to, procedures, industry related prohibitions, or salary and compensation thresholds.*

*All job postings are for existing vacancies. Please note; some interviews or new-hire training sessions may be held in person at one of our global offices.*

title: Product Manager/Strategy 3-ProdDev
job_description:
Work as part of a team that acts as the central resource and driving force for the design, process, manufacturing, test, quality and marketing of product(s) as they move from conception to distribution. Organize interdepartmental activities ensuring completion of the project/product on schedule and within budget.
  

* Engage with Oracle Cloud HCM Analytics customers to understand their needs, validate use cases, and gather feedback through interviews, focus groups, and design partnerships.
* Define product strategy, requirements, and roadmaps for HCM Analytics and AI agents, prioritizing customer value, usability, feasibility, and measurable outcomes.
* Identify high-value agentic use cases across HR and People Analytics, including conversational analysis, workforce trend investigation, guided insight discovery, and supported actions with appropriate user approvals.
* Define agent behavior and interaction requirements, including planning, tool selection, context management, clarification, human oversight, and recovery from errors.
* Partner with engineering to define how agents access governed analytical data, semantic models, enterprise knowledge, and application APIs while respecting user permissions and data access policies.
* Establish evaluation frameworks and acceptance criteria for response accuracy, analytical consistency, groundedness, task completion, latency, and cost.
* Work closely with design, engineering, data science, and QA teams to prototype, test, and deliver reliable analytics and agentic experiences.
* Present product strategy, roadmap priorities, and delivery tradeoffs to senior management and obtain alignment.
* Partner with Oracle Cloud HCM and other Oracle teams to shape the FDI roadmap and deliver integrated experiences.
* Review integration, regression, and AI evaluation test plans, including scenarios involving ambiguous requests, incomplete data, unauthorized access, and failed tool execution.
* Use customer feedback, product telemetry, and evaluation results to improve functionality and prioritize subsequent releases.
* Provide release documentation describing new capabilities, supported use cases, configuration requirements, and functional limitations.

**Farnell**

Farnell, an Avnet company, is a global high-service distributor of technology products, services and solutions for electronic system design, maintenance and repair.

**Role** Assistant Product Manager

**Business Function** Product

**Reports to** Senior APM

**Department** Product Operations

**Nature and Purpose:**

Supporting the Global Business Unit Leaders strategy in the execution of specific product technology plans. Completing product administration tasks and customer service within agreed service levels.

**Accountabilities with Key Outcomes:**

**1** Product Creation – Accountable for the creation of products as defined by Global Product Business Unit Leader

**2** Manages the product range – manages the portfolio of products throughout their life cycle. Including; system maintenance, ensuring products are in the optimum saleable position, PDD co-ordination, product maintenance / housekeeping and ad-hoc analytics.

**3** Customer Service - Accountable for responding to customer tickets and technical queries, including liaising with suppliers in multiple time-zones to resolve issues in a timely manner.

**4** Inventory – manage parts throughout the product lifecycle including; NPI performance, EOL, SKU flagging, Non-Stocked range management.

**5** Product Data Management – review online content of NPIs and legacy products and work with key stakeholders to make improvements to drive online sales.

**6** Marketing co-ordination – work with the Strategic Sourcing Group (SSG) and suppliers to provide content for agreed marketing activities.

**7** Quality – responsible for implementation process in line with the Quality Management System with exceptional levels of detail and accuracy in product content and presentation.

**8** **Knowledge, Skills and Experience:** Please give details of the knowledge, education, formal qualifications, specialized training or experience required for the job. Indicate whether requirement is **essential or desirable**.

Essential

* Exceptional focus on customer service, quality and attention to detail
* Excellent communication skills
* Comfortable speaking with multiple global stakeholders
* Experience in managing multiple priorities and meeting deadlines/SLA commitments
* Excel and IT skills
* Ability to work autonomously & drive results
* Strong quantitative and data management skills

Desirable

* Experience of working in electronics components industry/and or distribution
* Experience succeeding in a Global Matrix organization
* Experience working in a customer service environment
* Technical aptitude
* Experience of working within a quality assured environment.

* Direct impact on Sales, margin and market share of business unit
* Direct impact on supplier relationship through interaction and strong execution of product related matters
* Indirect influence over Asset, Sales, Marketing & e-Commerce through support of product strategy

**Decision-making Authority:** Indicate what decisions the job is expected to make and what it is expected to recommend.

* Limited. Decision making authority as directed by Business Unit leader, as a supporting role for this function

**Shift timings:**

UK shift - 1PM to 10 PM

title: Technical Product Manager – Lilly USA Data Analytics & AI
job_description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
Job Description
  
Technical Product Manager – Lilly USA Data Analytics & AI (DA&AI)
  
At Lilly, we believe in the talent of our workforce. One of the best ways to utilize and develop that talent is to use our existing workforce to fill new and/or open positions. If you are looking for a new position within Lilly, you can view and apply to open roles posted in the internal job posting system. You must meet the minimum qualifications outlined in the job description and have or obtain work authorization in the country where the position is to be considered. When applying internally, your current supervisor will receive notification that you have applied. We encourage employees to discuss the opportunity with their supervisor before applying.
  
  
Path/Level
  
P3
  
Job Title
  
Technical Product Manager, Lilly USA Tech@Lilly – DA&AI
  
Job Function
  
Information Technology
  
Location
  
India – Bangalore
  
Reports to
  
Director, CTI Commercial India, Tech@Lilly
  
  
**Note:** Roles are posted at the lowest level of a band. Employees hired into banded positions transfer at their current level, despite the level indicated in the posting.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
The Technical Product Manager (TPM) owns the product vision, roadmap, prioritization and value realization for Lilly USA Commercial Sales data and analytics products. The role translates the needs of Sales Operations, field leadership and commercial teams into trusted, reusable data products and analytical capabilities that improve field effectiveness, customer engagement and business decision-making.
  
This individual-contributor role combines strong Commercial Sales stakeholder partnership with formal product management accountability. It moves beyond demand intake and status coordination to owning product outcomes, roadmap decisions, prioritization, adoption and measurable business value.
  
The TPM owns the Sales vertical product direction and business outcomes while partnering with platform Product Owners, Data Architects, Business Analysts, Scrum Masters, engineering, quality and compliance teams that retain accountability for their respective platform, architecture and delivery responsibilities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Product vision, strategy and roadmap
  
  

* Define and communicate a multi-quarter data-product vision and roadmap for Commercial Sales, aligned with Commercial Unit priorities and the broader Data & AI strategy.
* Translate business problems such as field effectiveness, targeting and customer engagement into validated product opportunities, data requirements and measurable outcomes.
* Prioritize the roadmap and backlog using business value, urgency, strategic alignment, effort, risk, compliance, capacity and dependency trade-offs; make and defend scope decisions with leadership.
* Maintain a transparent roadmap, release outlook and product lifecycle plan, clearly communicating changes in priorities, capacity, funding or dependencies.
* Align the Sales roadmap with reusable enterprise capabilities, platform roadmaps and relevant AI innovation initiatives before approving vertical-specific development.

Product discovery and data-product definition
  
  

* Lead structured discovery with field users, Sales Operations, reporting teams to understand decisions, workflows, unmet needs and pain points before defining solutions.
* Validate problems and proposed product concepts through interviews, workflow observation, prototypes, data analysis, usability testing and field feedback.
* Define the business contract for each Sales data product, including intended consumers, decision use cases, product grain, key identifiers, business definitions, source systems, refresh expectations, quality thresholds, access requirements and service expectations, in partnership with the Business Analyst and Data Architect.
* Maintain a clear product catalogue covering product purpose, business owner, product owner, consumers, lifecycle status, dependencies, service expectations and adoption measures.

End-to-end product delivery and acceptance
  
  

* Own product outcomes from validated opportunity through production adoption, including scope, prioritization, release decisions, enablement and post-launch value tracking.
* Own product priorities, backlog ordering and timely scope decisions; partner with the Business Analyst to translate outcomes into epics, features, user stories, data requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with the Scrum Master so planning refinement, reviews and delivery ceremonies support product priorities and timely decisions.
* Work with data engineers, analysts, ML engineers, quality teams and architects to resolve product questions and make informed value, usability, risk and sequencing trade-offs.
* Establish business acceptance criteria, coordinate UAT with authorized Sales stakeholders and secure business sign-off before release.
* Ensure critical Sales measures are reconciled across source systems, data products and consuming reports before production adoption.
* Coordinate product acceptance and operational handover to downstream analytics and reporting teams, including documentation, access, support ownership and known limitations.
* Track delivery and product health, proactively surfacing risks, dependencies, quality concerns, cost considerations and mitigation decisions.

Stakeholder, portfolio and operating-model leadership
  
  

* Act as the single point of accountability and voice of the product for Commercial business partners, Sales Operations, field leadership and technology stakeholders.
* Lead regular Sales product reviews covering roadmap, value realized, adoption, product health, dependencies, risks and decisions required.
* Lead quarterly demand, capacity and sequencing discussions for the Sales data-product portfolio, balancing business value, urgency, strategic alignment, risk, technical dependencies and available delivery capacity.
* Assess existing enterprise data products, approved patterns and reusable platform capabilities before starting new development.
* Contribute to maintaining the Sales DA&AI operating model, decision rights and RACI, recommending updates when product, platform or delivery accountabilities change.
* Provide concise executive updates and evidence-based investment recommendations, including the consequences of funding, capacity and sequencing decisions.

Data, AI and regulated-environment stewardship
  
  

* Champion and apply architecture, data-governance, privacy, security, quality and compliance standards established by the accountable enterprise teams.
* Promote trusted business definitions, data quality, lineage, appropriate access and a consistent source of truth for Sales and Commercial measures.
* Identify and validate Sales problems that may benefit from analytics, machine learning, generative AI or agentic capabilities.
* Partner with Business Analysts and engineering teams to assess feasibility, data readiness, responsible-AI considerations and measurable business value.
* Support the transition of successful proofs of concept into governed, supportable and adoptable Sales products.

Value realization, adoption and lifecycle management
  
  

* Define success measures before investment and track outcomes after release, using appropriate business, product, data-quality, adoption and delivery measures.
* Drive change management, training, communications and field enablement so intended users adopt and benefit from the products.
* Continuously improve products through evidence-based releases, address low adoption or quality concerns and retire low-value or duplicative capabilities.

Role Accountability and Decision Rights
  
  
The TPM is accountable for why the product is needed, whom it serves, what outcomes it must deliver, what is prioritized and whether value is realized. The TPM partners with the Business Analyst on detailed requirements, the Scrum Master on delivery ceremonies, the Data Architect on architecture and governance standards, engineering and quality teams on implementation and validation, and platform Product Owners on reusable capabilities and technical roadmaps.
  
  
Qualifications and Skills
  
  
Required
  
  

* Relevant experience in technology, data, analytics or digital product delivery, including substantial experience owning data, analytics or AI products in complex enterprise environments.
* Proven record of owning product discovery, vision, roadmap, prioritization, delivery, adoption and lifecycle management in an Agile environment such as Scrum or SAFe.
* Experience working with Commercial Sales, Sales Operations, CRM, field-force or customer-engagement data and platforms such as Salesforce, Veeva or similar.
* Strong data literacy, including the ability to interpret data models, SQL outputs, dashboards, business measures, quality indicators and analytical results.
* Working knowledge of modern cloud data and analytics platforms, such as Databricks and AWS, including Lakehouse concepts, data pipelines, data modelling, semantic layers, business intelligence and ML/AI product lifecycles. The role is not expected to be a hands-on data engineer but must engage credibly with technical teams and make informed product trade-offs.
* Experience with product discovery, outcome-based roadmaps, business acceptance, UAT, product adoption and measurable product KPIs.
* Experience managing priorities, dependencies, capacity and sequencing across multiple business and delivery teams.
* Working knowledge of Jira or Azure DevOps for product backlog and roadmap management.
* Demonstrated understanding of data governance, privacy, security, quality, compliance and responsible AI in a regulated environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, stakeholder management, negotiation and consulting skills, including the ability to influence senior leaders and global cross-time-zone teams without formal authority.

Preferred
  
  

* Pharma, life sciences or healthcare Commercial experience across brand, sales operations, market access, marketing analytics or omnichannel engagement.
* Experience with AI/ML or generative-AI product use cases such as next-best action, forecasting, recommendation or copilots for Sales users.
* Experience handing data products over to downstream analytics, reporting or decision-support platforms.
* Familiarity with tools and services such as Confluence, Databricks, AWS, Power BI, Tableau, Redshift or Amazon S3.
* One of the Product, Agile certifications such as CSPO, SAFe POPM, PMP would be advantage.

Leadership Behaviors
  
  

* Creates urgency and momentum while making thoughtful product trade-offs.
* Influences without authority across multiple levels and functions.
* Communicates clearly, listens actively and builds trusted stakeholder relationships.
* Works constructively through ambiguity and keeps teams focused on outcomes and decisions.
* Uses analytical and critical thinking to identify product, data and delivery gaps.
* Balances customer advocacy with enterprise reuse, governance, quality and long-term product sustainability.

Internal Application Note
  
  
When applying internally for a position, your current supervisor receives notification that you have applied. We encourage employees to discuss the opportunity with their supervisor before applying.
  
Lilly does not discriminate based on age, race, colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.
  
#WeAreLilly
  
  
Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions. If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form (https://careers.lilly.com/us/en/workplace-accommodation) for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response.
  
  
Lilly does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.

* Coordinate product acceptance and operational handover to downstream analytics and reporting teams, including documentation, access, support ownership and known limitations.
* Track delivery and product health, proactively surfacing risks, dependencies, quality concerns, cost considerations and mitigation decisions.

Stakeholder, portfolio and operating-model leadership
  
  

* Act as the single point of accountability and voice of the product for Commercial business partners, Sales Operations, field leadership and technology stakeholders.
* Lead regular Sales product reviews covering roadmap, value realized, adoption, product health, dependencies, risks and decisions required.
* Lead quarterly demand, capacity and sequencing discussions for the Sales data-product portfolio, balancing business value, urgency, strategic alignment, risk, technical dependencies and available delivery capacity.
* Assess existing enterprise data products, approved patterns and reusable platform capabilities before starting new development.
* Contribute to maintaining the Sales DA&AI operating model, decision rights and RACI, recommending updates when product, platform or delivery accountabilities change.
* Provide concise executive updates and evidence-based investment recommendations, including the consequences of funding, capacity and sequencing decisions.

Data, AI and regulated-environment stewardship
  
  

* Champion and apply architecture, data-governance, privacy, security, quality and compliance standards established by the accountable enterprise teams.
* Promote trusted business definitions, data quality, lineage, appropriate access and a consistent source of truth for Sales and Commercial measures.
* Identify and validate Sales problems that may benefit from analytics, machine learning, generative AI or agentic capabilities.
* Partner with Business Analysts and engineering teams to assess feasibility, data readiness, responsible-AI considerations and measurable business value.
* Support the transition of successful proofs of concept into governed, supportable and adoptable Sales products.

Value realization, adoption and lifecycle management
  
  

* Define success measures before investment and track outcomes after release, using appropriate business, product, data-quality, adoption and delivery measures.
* Drive change management, training, communications and field enablement so intended users adopt and benefit from the products.
* Continuously improve products through evidence-based releases, address low adoption or quality concerns and retire low-value or duplicative capabilities.

Role Accountability and Decision Rights
  
  
The TPM is accountable for why the product is needed, whom it serves, what outcomes it must deliver, what is prioritized and whether value is realized. The TPM partners with the Business Analyst on detailed requirements, the Scrum Master on delivery ceremonies, the Data Architect on architecture and governance standards, engineering and quality teams on implementation and validation, and platform Product Owners on reusable capabilities and technical roadmaps.
  
  
Qualifications and Skills
  
  
Required
  
  

* Relevant experience in technology, data, analytics or digital product delivery, including substantial experience owning data, analytics or AI products in complex enterprise environments.
* Proven record of owning product discovery, vision, roadmap, prioritization, delivery, adoption and lifecycle management in an Agile environment such as Scrum or SAFe.
* Experience working with Commercial Sales, Sales Operations, CRM, field-force or customer-engagement data and platforms such as Salesforce, Veeva or similar.
* Strong data literacy, including the ability to interpret data models, SQL outputs, dashboards, business measures, quality indicators and analytical results.
* Working knowledge of modern cloud data and analytics platforms, such as Databricks and AWS, including Lakehouse concepts, data pipelines, data modelling, semantic layers, business intelligence and ML/AI product lifecycles. The role is not expected to be a hands-on data engineer but must engage credibly with technical teams and make informed product trade-offs.
* Experience with product discovery, outcome-based roadmaps, business acceptance, UAT, product adoption and measurable product KPIs.
* Experience managing priorities, dependencies, capacity and sequencing across multiple business and delivery teams.
* Working knowledge of Jira or Azure DevOps for product backlog and roadmap management.
* Demonstrated understanding of data governance, privacy, security, quality, compliance and responsible AI in a regulated environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, stakeholder management, negotiation and consulting skills, including the ability to influence senior leaders and global cross-time-zone teams without formal authority.

Preferred
  
  

* Pharma, life sciences or healthcare Commercial experience across brand, sales operations, market access, marketing analytics or omnichannel engagement.
* Experience with AI/ML or generative-AI product use cases such as next-best action, forecasting, recommendation or copilots for Sales users.
* Experience handing data products over to downstream analytics, reporting or decision-support platforms.
* Familiarity with tools and services such as Confluence, Databricks, AWS, Power BI, Tableau, Redshift or Amazon S3.
* One of the Product, Agile certifications such as CSPO, SAFe POPM, PMP would be advantage.

Leadership Behaviors
  
  

* Creates urgency and momentum while making thoughtful product trade-offs.
* Influences without authority across multiple levels and functions.
* Communicates clearly, listens actively and builds trusted stakeholder relationships.
* Works constructively through ambiguity and keeps teams focused on outcomes and decisions.
* Uses analytical and critical thinking to identify product, data and delivery gaps.
* Balances customer advocacy with enterprise reuse, governance, quality and long-term product sustainability.

title: Sr Product Manager - Marketplace
job_description:
**About us:**  
As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values different voices and lifts each other up. Here, we believe your unique perspective is  
important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful.  
  
**Team overview:**  
Right along with Target’s distinctive retail brand, we are constantly improving and innovating our digital shopping experience. Are you ready to excel in the fast-changing retail environment? Are you a customer service enthusiast who’s curious about the guest and can see the shopping journey through their eyes? Then you’ll have success on the Digital Strategy & Platform team, whose goal is to offer guests a seamless online shopping experience across our platforms—including Target.com and the store network’s fulfillment capabilities. Here, you’ll collaborate to create and implement the digital strategies that enrich the online experience through the right mix of personalization, simplicity and intuitiveness. Your ideas will support Target in complementing the beloved in-store shopping interaction with a convenient, reliable and instantly gratifying digital experience.  
  
We are seeking a **Sr** **Product Manager – Seller Tools & Engagement** to define and execute the strategy for how Target+ engages, guides, and enables sellers at scale.  
You will lead the strategy, vision, and execution of our Seller Portal. You will shape the ecosystem that empowers sellers, expands guest choice, and delivers scalable growth  
In this role, you will lead a charter that improves seller activation, compliance, performance, and adoption across the marketplace lifecycle. You will own the systems, signals, and experiences that shape seller behavior—driving measurable improvements in marketplace quality, operational efficiency, and seller success.  
  
This is a highly cross-functional, data-driven role requiring strong product judgment, systems thinking, and the ability to influence outcomes without authority. You will partner closely with engineering, design, operations, and analytics teams to deliver intelligent, scalable solutions that help sellers take the right actions at the right time.  
  
As a Senior Product Manager, you will take lead on - Owning seller lifecycle engagement, including activation, adoption, performance improvement, and re-engagement. Designing data-driven nudges, reminders, and interventions that influence seller behavior and improve compliance, quality, and productivity. Enabling sellers to easily understand what actions they need to take and why, reducing friction and support dependency. Driving measurable behavior change in seller success. Define KPIs for marketplace success Use data and experimentation (A/B testing, cohort analysis) to refine features and improve adoption. Drive AI/ML powered insights

**About you:**

* Four-year degree or equivalent experience.
* **6+ years of hands-on Product Management experience** or equivalent domain experience
* Proven success in **building and scaling marketplaces, platforms, or complex multi-sided ecosystem**
* Deep understanding of marketplace economics, seller ecosystems, and buyer behavior.
* Strong technical aptitude, experience working closely with business, engineering and data science and cross functional enterprise teams.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to think strategically while driving operational excellence.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Associate Product Manager
job_description:
The Opportunity

RoaDo helps shippers and logistics teams run domestic and cross-border freight on one connected platform. As a Product Manager, you'll take charge of one area of that platform. Depending on business needs at the time you join, it could be load planning, carrier sourcing and spot bidding, shipment visibility, our AI-driven control tower, digital proof of delivery, freight billing, or our export-import (EXIM) workflows. You'll partner with engineers, operations teams, and enterprise clients to turn real logistics problems into products that deliver clear business results.

Your Responsibilities

* Set the product direction and quarterly priorities for your area, and see them through to delivery

* Take full ownership of how users get work done in your module, from first sketch to everyday adoption

* Strengthen how RoaDo connects with the outside world: client ERPs, transporter systems, GPS and telematics devices, shipping lines, forwarders, customs brokers, and port terminals

* Give customers a single view of their international shipments, from factory gate to port, across the sea or air leg, and on to final delivery

* Spend regular time with exporters, importers, transporters, forwarders, and finance teams to find where work breaks down and decide what to fix first

* Write detailed requirement documents that leave little room for interpretation, and stay close to the engineering team through each sprint

* Choose the right success measures, such as usage, turnaround time, port dwell, and cost per shipment, and report on them consistently

What We're Looking For

* 3 to 5 years in product management, including at least 2 years running a B2B software product with full accountability

* Solid knowledge of road freight in India, both full-truckload and part-load, including how loads are planned, how transporters are selected, how trips are tracked, and how freight bills are settled

* Practical understanding of the truckload lifecycle: placing orders with transporters, monitoring trip milestones, handling waiting charges, and closing payments

* Good knowledge of export-import operations, including space booking, container handling at CFS and ICD, port movement, customs filing, and coordination with shipping lines and forwarders

* Comfort with core trade documents and terms such as Bill of Lading, Shipping Bill, Bill of Entry, Incoterms, and demurrage and detention charges

* Experience with exception alerts, live visibility, or control-tower style products will set you apart

* Able to read API docs and work through integration details with engineers, including GPS and SIM-based tracking, container tracking feeds, webhooks, and ERP connections

* A data-driven mindset: you can estimate the size of a problem, pick the metric that matters, and build a persuasive case from numbers

* Strong written communication and the ability to align engineering and business teams around a spec

How You Use AI

We give real weight to this. RoaDo PMs are expected to use AI as part of their everyday toolkit.

* You regularly use tools like Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor to analyse data and find patterns in product logs, customer tickets, and call notes

* You can quickly build a working prototype or demo to test an idea before engineering time is spent

* You use AI to speed up research, produce first drafts of specs, and challenge your own assumptions early

* You think about how AI can change what our product does for customers, such as reading trade documents automatically or predicting delays, and not only how it speeds up building

Bonus Points

* Background in multi-tenant enterprise SaaS

* Hands-on experience with freight forwarding, 3PL, or shipping line software, or with platforms like ICEGATE, PCS, or ULIP

* Exposure to multimodal freight across road, rail, sea, and air

* Working knowledge of Mixpanel, Metabase, Jira, or similar tools

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: ₹749,301.00 - ₹1,100,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Internet reimbursement
* Work from home

Work Location: In person

author: Hiring Manager
title: Associate Product Manager
job_description:
### **Job Summary**

We are seeking an enthusiastic and driven Associate Product Manager to join our growing product team. This role is an excellent opportunity for an aspiring product leader to contribute to the development and launch of innovative products. The Associate Product Manager will support the product lifecycle from ideation to launch, working closely with engineering, design, marketing, and sales teams to deliver exceptional user experiences and achieve business objectives.  

### **Key Responsibilities:**

* Assist in conducting market research, competitive analysis, and user interviews to identify market opportunities and user needs.
* Support the definition of product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria for new features and enhancements.
* Collaborate with UX/UI designers to create intuitive and engaging product experiences.
* Work closely with engineering teams throughout the development lifecycle, participating in sprint planning, stand-ups, and reviews.
* Help manage the product backlog, prioritize features, and ensure alignment with the overall product roadmap.
* Assist in analyzing product performance data, user feedback, and market trends to inform product decisions.
* Prepare and deliver presentations on product updates, features, and performance to internal stakeholders.
* Support product launch activities, including developing internal training materials and working with marketing on external communications.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of product management processes and methodologies.
* Act as a liaison between technical and non-technical teams, translating complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Vice President - Lending Product Owner
job_description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

If you aspire to be a part of a team that innovates new product offerings and leads the end-to-end product life cycle this is the role for you.

As a Lending Product Owner in Wealth Management Solutions team, you will be an integral part of the team that innovates new product offerings and leads the end-to-end product life cycle. As a core leader, you are responsible for acting as the voice of the customer and developing profitable products that provide customer value.

You will need to be outcome focused and foster an environment of continual innovation based on data interpretation, customer / stakeholder interviews and adopting latest digital technologies to enhance client experience and maximize profitability. Utilizing your deep understanding of how to get a product off the ground, you guide the successful launch of products, gather crucial feedback, and ensure top-tier client experiences. With a strong commitment to scalability, resiliency, and stability, you collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality products that exceed customer expectations

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Develops a product strategy and product vision that delivers value to customers
* Manages discovery efforts and market research to uncover customer solutions and integrate them into the product roadmap
* Owns, maintains, and develops a product backlog that enables development to support the overall strategic roadmap and value proposition
* Lead agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives.
* Leads the Product Testing Strategy & Release management strategy by working closely with Testing Centre of Excellence
* Lead, mentor, and support a team of product analyst/associates, fostering their growth and development.
* Facilitate collaboration and communication within the team and with other departments.
* Act as the primary point of contact for product-related queries and updates.
* Continuously improve processes to enhance productivity and product quality.

**Required qualifications, capabilities and skills**

* Graduate / Post-Graduate, with a minimum of 6 years of experience in Banking / Financial Services of which at least 3 should be in a similar role & profile.
* Expertise in defining, building out product strategy and roadmap and Strong prioritization skills
* Advanced knowledge of the product development life cycle
* Data & Tech Literacy - Leverages data analytics and digital skills to create new insights and deliver well designed applications that together support business transformation
* Market & Product Knowledge - Demonstrates a thorough understanding of our products, systems and end to end processes, and keeps abreast of market and industry trends
* Continuous Improvement - Applies innovation and design thinking techniques to continually challenge and improve the efficiency, scale, and resilience of our operating platform
* Team management experience, leading a team of ICs and managers.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills**

* Influencing skills to manage a variety of stakeholders from different functions
* Team player who proactively shares knowledge and information within and outside the function

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  
  
J.P. Morgan Asset & Wealth Management delivers industry-leading investment management and private banking solutions. Asset Management provides individuals, advisors and institutions with strategies and expertise that span the full spectrum of asset classes through our global network of investment professionals. Wealth Management helps individuals, families and foundations take a more intentional approach to their wealth or finances to better define, focus and realize their goals.
